item.title: Desculpas de Infantino não convencem Inglaterra e Alemanha sobre futuro da Fifa
item.description: Gianni Infantino pediu desculpas ao Conselho da Fifa na quinta-feira, mas os dirigentes do futebol inglês e alemão afirmaram não estar convencidos de que ele estivesse apto a continuar como presidente da entidade que rege o futebol mundial.
item.dc:creator: Iain Axon
item.content:encoded: Gianni Infantino pediu desculpas ao Conselho da Fifa na quinta-feira, mas os dirigentes do futebol inglês e alemão afirmaram não estar convencidos de que ele estivesse apto a continuar como presidente da entidade que rege o futebol mundial. Infantino disse que havia se desculpado durante a reunião a portas fechadas pelos erros na comunicação e nas consultas sobre o projeto Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE), agora abandonado, mas ressaltou que se tratava apenas de uma proposta e “de forma alguma de um acordo fechado”. “Em primeiro lugar, pedi desculpas pelos erros que cometemos em relação ao processo de comunicação e consulta relacionado ao projeto Fifa Forward Enterprise, o que acabou gerando muitas consequências”, disse Infantino em um vídeo publicado pela Fifa. “Mas o que é importante lembrar é que se tratava de uma proposta, portanto, de forma alguma um acordo fechado.” O plano da FFE previa a criação de uma empresa para administrar os interesses comerciais das competições da Fifa, incluindo a Copa do Mundo, e a venda de uma participação minoritária a investidores privados. Infantino afirmou que o objetivo era gerar recursos adicionais para as 211 federações-membro da Fifa. Embora Infantino parecesse manter forte apoio entre as autoridades africanas, a oposição de algumas das federações de futebol mais influentes da Europa continuava acentuada. O presidente da Federação Alemã de Futebol, Bernd Neuendorf, pediu um “recomeço completo” na Fifa, afirmando que as reformas de governança de que a organização precisa não podem ser realizadas com Infantino no comando. “A primeira coisa é que precisamos de reformas. Isso é verdade. E todo mundo sabe disso”, disse Neuendorf. “A antiga administração precisa ser reformada, e toda a governança precisa ser reformada. Mas estou bem claro quanto a isso: isso não é possível com o Gianni.” “Portanto, precisamos de um recomeço completo, creio eu, um recomeço político.” A presidente da Federação Inglesa de Futebol (FA), Debbie Hewitt, disse que Infantino precisa dar respostas às perguntas levantadas pelos membros do Conselho da Fifa e alertou que, caso não o faça, ele não estará apto a permanecer como presidente. “Acho que ele precisa responder a essas perguntas”, declarou Hewitt. “E se ele não responder a essas perguntas, não, ele não está apto a ser presidente da Fifa.”

item.title: Volvo Cars expands automated driving partnership with Nvidia
item.description: Volvo Cars is expanding its partnership with Nvidia to develop a new generation of driver-assistance and automated-driving technology, the companies said on Thursday, as carmakers race to bring increasingly advanced hands-free driving features to market.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Volvo Cars (VOLCARb.ST) is expanding its partnership with Nvidia (NVDA.O) to [USN:L6N3Y610S TEXT:"develop"] a new generation of driver-assistance and automated-driving technology, the companies said on Thursday, as carmakers race to bring increasingly advanced hands-free driving features to market. The companies said Volvo would combine its safety systems and engineering expertise with Nvidia's artificial intelligence and computing technologies, including the Hyperion sensor, computer architecture and autonomous-driving software stack. Alwin Bakkenes, Volvo Cars' head of software engineering, told Reuters the first deployment would focus on supervised driving features, with drivers remaining responsible for the vehicle. Bakkenes said Volvo's ambition was to gradually introduce more advanced capabilities, including hands-free driving in urban areas and on highways. The move comes as automakers including Mercedes-Benz, BMW and Ford target more advanced automated-driving systems, from hands-free highway driving to self-driving operations in limited conditions. Tesla is [USN:L6N45R0YL TEXT:"pushing"] for broader [USN:L6N45V0PF TEXT:"approval"] of its assisted-driving technology in Europe, including urban areas with an EU-wide [USN:L6N45H0TX TEXT:"vote"] possible in December. The technology should appear in Volvo vehicles before 2030 and will be launched in multiple regions simultaneously, excluding China, Bakkenes said. Volvo, which is majority owned by China's Geely Holding (GEELY.UL), has not chosen a pricing model yet, Bakkenes said, but features would not just be available for higher-priced models. Besides Volvo, Nvidia has [USN:L1N3Y90FP TEXT:"partnerships"] with a wide range of automakers, including Mercedes, Jaguar Land Rover and Hyundai. "The most important functionality of autonomous driving assist technology is safety," Nvidia automotive chief Ali Kani told Reuters. "We believe that we're going to make the stack safer getting to work with Volvo."

item.title: Ex-Mets manager Carlos Mendoza joins Phillies' coaching staff
item.description: The Philadelphia Phillies continued to build their coaching staff on Thursday, naming former New York Mets manager Carlos Mendoza as the infield and third-base coach.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Philadelphia Phillies continued to build their coaching staff on Thursday, naming former New York Mets manager Carlos Mendoza as the infield and third-base coach. General manager Dave Dombrowski confirmed the move during his end-of-season news conference in Philadelphia. The announcement comes two days after the Phillies named interim manager Don Mattingly their full-time skipper. In his first season as Mets manager in 2024, Mendoza led the team to an 89-73 finish and a berth in the National League Championship Series. The Mets lost to the Los Angeles Dodgers in six games. Mendoza, 46, was fired halfway through the 2026 season as the Mets stood 34-47. His total record in New York was 206-199. Reports Wednesday said the Phillies dismissed hitting coach Kevin Long and infield coach Bobby Dickerson. The Phillies ranked 28th in the majors in defensive efficiency in 2025. Mendoza previously served as a roving defensive instructor in the New York Yankees' farm system, then infield coach on the Yankees' big-league staff. --Field Level Media

item.title: Safe havens
item.description: Hello there. The global selloff in the AI trade is sending investors piling into government bonds. They’re searching for safe havens as rising interest rates stoke concern about whether the billions poured into artificial intelligence will deliver sufficient returns.
item.dc:creator: Carmel Crimmins
item.content:encoded: Hello there. The [USN:L6N46100A TEXT:"global selloff"] in the AI trade is sending investors piling into government bonds. They’re searching for [USN:L4N46108S TEXT:"safe havens"] as rising interest rates stoke[USN:L4N4610PE TEXT:" concern"] about whether the billions poured into artificial intelligence will deliver sufficient returns. US Treasuries rose across the curve and even French bonds got a boost, though not as much as other government paper. No surprises there: AI may have its financing problems but so does Paris. I homed in on France’s fiscal fault lines in this week’s Econ World podcast, specifically the generational battle over resources. The protests by French students over [USN:L1N45U0DV TEXT:"dilapidated schools"] and overcrowded classrooms are a natural sequel to the demonstrations that roiled France back in 2023 when President Emmanuel Macron tried to raise the retirement age from 62 to 64. In each case, the protesters see themselves in a fight with the government over resources, but in reality they are in a battle with each other over how those [USN:L1N45Z0DQ TEXT:"resources"] are divided up. Interestingly, my colleague Leigh Thomas, who covers the French economy, says the students don’t see it that way. You can catch the whole episode here . THE HEADLINES [USN:FWN4610DW TEXT:"Ukraine resumes strikes on Russian refineries as Zelenskiy says 'we're done'"] Russia builds major new drone attack base in six weeks, satellite images show [USN:L8N4601CJ TEXT:"Banks, buildings burn as Albania's capital Tirana erupts into student violence"] [USN:L8N46019A TEXT:"Two ships sink near Hormuz after being hit by projectiles amid surge in attacks"] The bump to bonds from the AI rout could be a big relief for governments looking to finance their budgets, but as columnist Mike Dolan points out, they should [USN:L6N45Z13S TEXT:"be careful"] what they wish for. The [USN:L1N45Z05I TEXT:"International Monetary Fund"] is flagging significant growth and financial stability risks from a potential ending of the AI investment boom. Geographically speaking, South Korea is the [USN:L1N46100C TEXT:"epicentre"] of the selloff because its market is so heavily concentrated on chip stocks, amplified by leveraged retail bets. Stocks there closed down nearly 8% on Thursday. But looking at individual names, [USN:L4N4610C3 TEXT:"CoreWeave"] is at the eye of the storm. CoreWeave is a neocloud, a term used to describe companies that rent out computing power and other services to tech companies like Microsoft and Alphabet’s Google. These computing suppliers have borrowed big to finance their growth and investors are now separating off AI companies that have solid cash balances from those that need debt to build. CoreWeave owes nearly $50 billion and saw one-fifth of its equity value vaporised on Wednesday. Its debt is trading at a 20% discount and the cost of [USN:L4N4610DV TEXT:"insuring"] the company against default has blown out past 1,000 bps, according to LSEG data, meaning it now costs over $10 to insure $100 worth of bonds. In [USN:L4N4601XL TEXT:"a note"] to reassure staff, the company's CEO pointed out that it had a revenue backlog of over $100 billion in the second quarter and said markets can sometimes "misunderstand and act irrationally". THE CHART President Trump agreed a [USN:L4N45Y0AR TEXT:"surprise deal"] with Russian President Vladimir Putin to release around 2.25 million barrels of Russian diesel onto US and global markets. But that amount is less than a day's supply for the US transport sector alone. THE PODCAST "When you look at the opinion polls in France, there's a recognition that the public retirement system is not financially sound and sustainable, but there is not a majority of people that want to increase the retirement age. So, something's got to give at some point." Students are protesting all over France about poor conditions in schools. But as Leigh Thomas tells me on this week's Econ World, their frustrations may go much deeper. Watch it here . THE REAL WORLD China: Protein from Chinese producers is filling up global supermarket shelves . Not everyone is happy about it. New Delhi: India is cracking down hard on protests, with allegations of excessive force by police. Ohio: Republicans are facing a tough battle trying to [USN:L1N45V0SB TEXT:"hold onto their Senate seat"] in Ohio. THE WEEK AHEAD October 19: China Q3 GDP October 21: UK CPI October 22: US initial jobless claims

item.title: Acciones europeas tocan máximo de más de dos semanas ya que resultados mejoran el ánimo del mercado
item.description: Las bolsas europeas alcanzaron el jueves su nivel más alto en más de dos semanas, impulsadas por unos sólidos resultados y por el repunte de los valores del sector sanitario, que se han convertido en un refugio para los inversores internacionales ante el desvanecimiento del impulso de la inteligencia artificial.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas europeas alcanzaron el jueves su nivel más alto en más de dos semanas, impulsadas por unos sólidos resultados y por el repunte de los valores del sector sanitario, que se han convertido en un refugio para los inversores internacionales ante el desvanecimiento del impulso de la inteligencia artificial. * Las acciones de Ericsson (ERICb.ST) treparon un 6,8% y fueron las que más avanzaron en el índice de referencia después de que el fabricante sueco de equipos de telecomunicaciones presentó unos resultados del tercer trimestre mejores de lo esperado. * Los inversores han depositado sus esperanzas en una sólida temporada de resultados para sacar al STOXX 600 del estrecho rango en el que ha estado confinado durante el último mes. * El jueves, el índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) subió un 0,38%, a 640,16 puntos, tras alcanzar a primera hora de la sesión su máximo desde el 30 de septiembre. * El índice del sector sanitario (.SXDP) ganó un 2,4% y se situó entre los valores que más subieron del referencial. Las acciones tecnológicas (.SX8P) perdieron un 1,5% y lideraron las caídas, arrastradas por la baja del 13% del fabricante alemán de sistemas de chips Aixtron (AIXGn.DE) . * Las acciones de las firmas de semiconductores Infineon (IFXGn.DE) y Soitec (SOIT.PA) cedieron un 5,2% y un 7,7%, respectivamente, mientras que el fabricante de equipos para semiconductores ASML (ASML.AS) retrocedió un 4,2%. * Las acciones tecnológicas de todo el mundo se vieron sacudidas después de que los elevados datos de inflación de Estados Unidos del miércoles avivaron los temores de nuevas subidas de tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal, lo que afectó a las compañías que dependen del endeudamiento para financiar la construcción de infraestructuras de inteligencia artificial. * Mondi (MNDI.L) se desplomó un 7,9%, luego de que la firma de papel y embalajes anunció que había subido los precios de varios tipos de papel en el tercer trimestre para contrarrestar los costos de la energía y las materias primas. * Antofagasta (ANTO.L) cayó un 4,1%, después de que la minera informó de una producción de cobre de 436.900 toneladas en lo que va de año, un 8,3% menos que en el mismo periodo de 2025. Esta caída, junto con el descenso de los precios del cobre, provocó que el sector minero (.SXPP) descendiera un 0,8%.

item.title: Dave Hakstol hired at Arizona State, Greg Powers exits amid probe into collapse
item.description: Colorado Avalanche assistant Dave Hakstol has been named head coach at Arizona State while Greg Powers has left the program, the university announced Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Colorado Avalanche assistant Dave Hakstol has been named head coach at Arizona State while Greg Powers has left the program, the university announced Thursday. Powers was placed on paid administrative leave last month after seven members of the Division I team asked the university to remove him pending an investigation into the collapse of defenseman Matthew Mayich during an outdoor workout on Aug. 20. Per Robert Carey, the attorney for the Mayich family, the player is not expected to recover after exertional heat stroke reduced the flow of oxygen to his brain. Powers said he had "mutually agreed to leave" his position in a statement provided by the university on his behalf. He has been the Sun Devils' head coach all 12 seasons for which they have been a Division I team, posting a 165-183-25 record. He took ASU to the NCAA Tournament during the 2018-19 season. Powers, 49, signed a five-year contract extension last year, when the university endowed the men's hockey head coach position in his name. "(Arizona State) reached a mutual agreement to part ways with hockey coach Greg Powers," the university wrote in an email to the Arizona Republic. "The university and Sun Devil Athletics are grateful for Coach Powers' work to establish ASU as a Division I hockey program and for his service over the past nearly two decades." Hakstol, 58, will be behind the Sun Devils' bench for games on Friday and Saturday at UMass Lowell, the university announced. "This is a special opportunity, and I couldn't be more excited to return to college hockey and bring a winning culture to Arizona State Sun Devil Hockey," Hakstol said. "Our goal is to grow a championship-caliber program, and we will." Hakstol spent 11 seasons as the head coach at North Dakota (2004-15) before serving as the bench boss for the Philadelphia Flyers (2015-19) and Seattle Kraken (2021-24). He has been an assistant with the Avalanche for parts of the past two seasons. "We welcome Dave Hakstol and his family to Arizona State University. His success building championship-caliber programs, developing players for the highest level of the sport, and leading organizations in the NHL speaks to his knowledge of the game and his ability to develop talent," Arizona State athletic director Graham Rossini said. "We appreciate Dave's belief in ASU and look forward to supporting him as we continue to build Sun Devil Hockey into one of the nation's premier programs." --Field Level Media

item.title: Hass signs Rafael Camara to F1 seat to replace Esteban Ocon
item.description: Haas has signed 21-year-old Formula 2 driver Rafael Camara to fill its vacant Formula 1 seat starting in 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Haas has signed 21-year-old Formula 2 driver Rafael Camara to fill its vacant Formula 1 seat starting in 2027. The Brazilian driver will replace Esteban Ocon, who announced last month that he is leaving Haas after two seasons. Camara, who currently leads the F2 standings as a rookie, secured a multi-year deal to make his F1 debut with Haas. Haas conducted tests with reserve drivers Ryo Hirakawa and Jack Doohan and reigning F2 champ Leonardo Fornaroli. Camara became the leading target, however, following a private test with Haas in August at Portimao in Portugal. "He showed when we had him drive in our (test) program in Portugal that he could handle himself very well with not a huge amount of time to learn the car," Ayao Komatsu, Haas F1 team principal, said in a statement. "He showed us more than just raw speed. Rafa managed to create an environment to get the best out of himself, it was very impressive and certainly the laps he completed were special." Camara, who joined the Ferrari Driver Academy in 2022, won the Formula 3 title in 2025 driving for Trident. He is driving for Invicta Racing this season and has recorded three wins and five pole positions. He leads the F2 standings by seven points with two races remaining. --Field Level Media

item.title: Magazine Luiza faz parceria com Shopee para ampliar vendas de estoque próprio
item.description: A Magazine Luiza iniciou nesta quinta-feira uma parceria com a Shopee para levar itens de seu estoque próprio ao marketplace digital.
item.dc:creator: Igor Sodre
item.content:encoded: A Magazine Luiza (MGLU3.SA) iniciou nesta quinta-feira uma parceria com a Shopee para levar itens de seu estoque próprio ao marketplace digital. O acordo abrange o sortimento das marcas Magazine Luiza e KaBuM!, incluindo produtos como eletrodomésticos, eletroeletrônicos, móveis, videogames e produtos de informática, que estarão disponíveis na seção Lojas Oficiais da Shopee. O operação de entrega dos produtos será feita completamente pelo Magalog, operador logístico independente do Magalu. Com a parceria, o Grupo Magalu poderá utilizar serviços de social commerce da Shopee, como Shopee Lives, Shopee Vídeos, além das campanhas de datas duplas da plataforma. Fundada em Cingapura em 2015 e presente no Brasil há mais de seis anos, a Shopee afirma ser acessada por cerca de 90 milhões de brasileiros mensalmente e ter 95% das vendas vindas de vendedores locais. "Estamos agregando audiência em diferentes canais digitais para alcançar ainda mais clientes e ampliar as nossas vendas de forma acelerada e rentável”, disse Fabrício Garcia, vice-presidente comercial e de operações do Magalu. "Queremos transformar essa audiência adicional da Shopee em crescimento sustentável para o Magalu e para as marcas do nosso ecossistema." As ações do Magazine Luiza subiam às 14h, avançando 1,6% e cotadas a R$11,02. No mesmo horário, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) recuava 0,5%. A empresa tem focado em parcerias com grandes marketplaces que atuam no Brasil. Anteriormente, a companhia formou parceria com Aliexpress, em meados de 2024, e em novembro do ano passado acertou acordo com a [USN:L1N3WU0XG TEXT:"Americanas"] (AMER3.SA) . Enquanto isso, a [USN:L1N3W40SF TEXT:"Casas Bahia"] (BHIA3.SA) tem parceria com o Mercado Livre (MELI.O) anunciada em outubro de 2025.

item.title: Jon Rahm to forfeit remaining payments in LIV Golf settlement
item.description: Jon Rahm wants out of his commitment with LIV Golf and is willing to leave millions of dollars behind to achieve that, Front Office Sports reported Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jon Rahm wants out of his commitment with LIV Golf and is willing to leave millions of dollars behind to achieve that, Front Office Sports reported Thursday. The league filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in New Jersey last month, and per court filings reviewed by the outlet, Rahm has agreed to a separation agreement. It calls for him to end attempts to collect $7.47 million owed to him from past events, plus future earnings owed to him under his LIV contract. Rahm joined the fledgling league in 2024. While contract terms never were revealed, it is believed the Spanish superstar signed a contract in the range of $300 million and is still owed more than $100 million in future guarantees. He additionally earned more than $106 million in prize and bonus money on the course. He won the individual season championship in each of his three seasons with LIV. LIV Golf's future was thrown into turmoil in the spring when officials from the Saudi Arabian group that had been paying the bills said it would stop funding the circuit. BC Partners Credit, an investment firm, is prepared to provide $300 million to finance what is being called LIV 2.0, should the league emerge from bankruptcy. Rahm, who turns 32 next month, already said he had no plans to be a part of the next generation of LIV. He is a member of the DP World Tour, and the two-time major winner can try to seek to return to the PGA Tour, though CEO Brian Rolapp has given no indication that the tour will welcome back those who left it for LIV. The next hearing is scheduled for Nov. 5, at which time Rahm's separation agreement will be up for final approval from U.S. Bankruptcy Court of New Jersey Judge Michael B. Kaplan. --Field Level Media

item.title: Revolution Medicines' Europe efforts signal solo launch ambitions for cancer drug
item.description: Revolution Medicines is laying the groundwork for a broad European commercial rollout of its pancreatic cancer drug, signaling confidence in its ability to bring the therapy to market without relying on a local partner to help sell it.
item.dc:creator: Sriparna Roy, Bhanvi Satija
item.content:encoded: Revolution Medicines (RVMD.O) is laying the groundwork for a broad European commercial rollout of its pancreatic cancer drug, signaling confidence in its ability to bring the therapy to market without relying on a local partner to help sell it. Following [USN:L1N41Y1BC TEXT:"impressive clinical data"] against the notoriously difficult-to-treat cancer, analysts forecast peak annual global sales of $11.5 billion for Revolution's Rasonque, which [USN:L4N44N170 TEXT:"won speedy US approval"] in August after an FDA expedited review. The [USN:L4N4611GV TEXT:"European Medicines Agency's human medicines committee"] on Thursday recommended a marketing authorization for the oral drug, known chemically as daraxonrasib. It will now be reviewed by the European Commission. Small biotechs such as Revolution Medicines typically strike regional licensing deals in markets where they lack the scale or expertise to negotiate with government health systems, and in some cases ultimately sell themselves to larger drugmakers. "We are doing everything that we can practically do to make this product available on as global a basis as possible," RevMed CEO Mark Goldsmith said in an interview last month. "But it is more complicated on a country-by-country basis." RevMed's shares have more than doubled so far this year, giving it a market value of $41.5 billion. The company is applying lessons from the accelerated US approval process to markets abroad, with its most advanced efforts in Europe. Three Wall Street analysts said they believe Revolution can succeed with a solo push in Europe, despite this being its first approved drug. The California-based company has been building a strong presence in several key European markets, expanding its regulatory, medical, market access and commercial infrastructure, it told Reuters. Revolution said direct commercialization would also allow it to convey its deep knowledge of the drug to health systems and doctors. It is seeking approvals through Project Orbis, an FDA-coordinated program for simultaneous submission to the EMA, the UK's MHRA, Health Canada, and Australia. The parallel route could help shorten approval timelines by allowing shared regulatory data instead of separate reviews by each country. ROYALTY PHARMA CUSHION CEO Goldsmith declined to comment on any takeover speculation. The company said it may work with external partners in markets where local expertise is needed, but is focused on building its own global commercial presence for the drug and the company's broader pipeline. "It seems doable," said RBC Capital Markets analyst Leonid Timashev, of the company's ability to launch the drug independently. "They have certainly been hiring in a way that would indicate that that's something that they are going to try." Revolution's deal with Royalty Pharma (RPRX.O) that provides the drugmaker with up to $2 billion in development and marketing funding, has largely dispelled investor expectations that it would need to pursue a commercialization partner outside the United States, analysts said. Royalty Pharma is the world's largest buyer of biopharmaceutical royalties, which can provide funding for drug development. Royalty also recently tied up with BeOne Medicines (688235.SS) in China and certain Asian markets on an [USN:L4N3UH0M0 TEXT:"Amgen AMGN.O lung cancer drug"]. OVERSEAS HIRING PUSH Stifel analyst Laura Prendergast, who expects the drug will hit $3.2 billion to $3.3 billion in peak sales outside the US, mostly from Europe and Japan, said Revolution's key hires over the last year and a half are focused on global infrastructure. Anthony Mancini joined the company last year as chief global commercialization officer from Denmark's Genmab (GMAB.CO) , bringing over 25 years of experience in international markets. He also spent more than two decades at Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY.N) . Hiring activity on LinkedIn shows that the company has advertised for at least 50 roles across the UK and Europe in the last month. These include positions requiring commercial and regulatory expertise in countries such as Germany, Italy, France and the Netherlands. "Germany is a big focus for RevMed right now," said Stifel's Prendergast. "After they get the EMA approval, eyes will likely be on where Germany prices and that'll set the precedent for the rest of Europe."

item.title: India markets regulator partly reverses derivative settlement rules after pushback
item.description: India's markets regulator said on Thursday it would use volume-weighted average prices (VWAP) from the final 30 minutes of regular trading to settle expiring stock and index derivatives contracts, reversing its decision to use closing auction prices.
item.dc:creator: Jayshree Pyasi, Bharath Rajeswaran, Vivek M
item.content:encoded: India's markets regulator said on Thursday it would use volume-weighted average prices (VWAP) from the final 30 minutes of regular trading to settle expiring stock and index derivatives contracts, reversing its decision to use closing auction prices. The closing auction session (CAS) will continue to determine the closing prices of applicable cash-equity securities, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said in a circular. CAS, implemented by SEBI from August 3, had triggered a backlash from traders after sharp swings in stock and index levels during the close. Erratic movements in the expiring derivatives contracts propelled traders to pull back on volumes. Reuters [USN:L1N45R0C2 TEXT:"reported"] last week that SEBI was considering reverting to 30-minute VWAP-based settlements for expiring derivatives contracts. The changes will be effective from December 7. CAS will operate as a separate 10-minute session from 3:30 p.m. to 3:40 p.m. on all trading days. Order entry will close randomly between 3:38 p.m. and 3:40 p.m. Traders can enter both limit and market orders from 3:31 p.m. to 3:36 p.m., after which they may place only limit orders. A market order is executed immediately at the best available price, while a limit order is executed only at the investor's specified price or better. Expiring index derivatives will cease trading at 3:30 p.m. on expiry days. Stock derivatives will continue to trade until 3:45 p.m. on all trading days, including expiry days. The cash-market post-close session will run from 3:50 p.m. to 4 p.m., with trades executed at the closing price.

item.title: Ações europeias marcam maior nível em mais de duas semanas com impulso de balanços
item.description: As ações europeias atingiram seu maior nível em mais de duas semanas nesta quinta-feira, impulsionadas por balanços sólidos e por uma alta nas ações do setor de saúde, que se tornaram um porto seguro para os investidores globais à medida que o otimismo em torno da inteligência artificial (IA) vai diminuindo.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: As ações europeias atingiram seu maior nível em mais de duas semanas nesta quinta-feira, impulsionadas por balanços sólidos e por uma alta nas ações do setor de saúde, que se tornaram um porto seguro para os investidores globais à medida que o otimismo em torno da inteligência artificial (IA) vai diminuindo. As ações da Ericsson (ERICb.ST) subiram 6,8% e foram as que mais valorizaram no índice de referência, depois que a fabricante sueca de equipamentos de telecomunicações divulgou resultados do terceiro trimestre melhores do que o esperado. Os investidores depositam suas esperanças em uma temporada de resultados corporativos robusta para tirar o STOXX 600 da faixa estreita em que ficou confinado no último mês. O índice pan-europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) subiu 0,38% nesta quinta-feira, para 640,16 pontos, após atingir o maior nível desde 30 de setembro mais cedo no pregão. O índice do setor de saúde (.SXDP) subiu 2,4% e ficou entre os que mais valorizaram no índice de referência. As ações do setor de tecnologia (.SX8P) caíram 1,5% e lideraram as perdas, prejudicadas pela queda de 13% da fabricante alemã de sistemas de chips Aixtron (AIXGn.DE) . As ações de chips da Infineon (IFXGn.DE) e da Soitec (SOIT.PA) caíram 5,2% e 7,7%, respectivamente, enquanto a fabricante de equipamentos para chips ASML (ASML.AS) registrou queda de 4,2%. As ações do setor de tecnologia em todo o mundo foram abaladas depois que dados alarmantes sobre a inflação nos EUA, divulgados na quarta-feira, alimentaram temores de novos aumentos nas taxas de juros pelo Federal Reserve, afetando empresas que dependem de dívida para financiar a expansão de infraestruturas de IA. A Mondi (MNDI.L) despencou 7,9% depois que a empresa de papel e embalagens informou que aumentou os preços de vários tipos de papel no terceiro trimestre para compensar os custos de energia e matérias-primas. A Antofagasta (ANTO.L) caiu 4,1% depois que a mineradora divulgou uma produção de cobre de 436.900 toneladas no acumulado do ano, uma queda de 8,3% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025. A queda, somada aos preços mais baixos do cobre, levou o setor de mineração (.SXPP) a cair 0,8%. Os preços ao consumidor na França subiram 3,4% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior em setembro, com base na harmonização da União Europeia, em linha com uma estimativa preliminar do final de setembro. Os operadores estimam uma probabilidade de 87% de que o Banco Central Europeu realize um aumento de 0,25 ponto percentual na taxa de juros em dezembro, de acordo com dados da LSEG, após ter elevado as taxas duas vezes no início deste ano para combater a inflação impulsionada pelos preços mais altos da energia. O índice pan-europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) fechou em alta de 0,33%, a 639,85 pontos. Em LONDRES, o índice Financial Times (.FTSE) avançou 1,08%, a 10.840,35 pontos. Em FRANKFURT, o índice DAX (.GDAXI) subiu 0,27%, a 25.368,04 pontos. Em PARIS, o índice CAC-40 (.FCHI) ganhou 0,78%, a 7.934,70 pontos. Em MILÃO, o índice Ftse/Mib (.FTMIB) teve desvalorização de 0,72%, a 49.397,55 pontos. Em MADRI, o índice Ibex-35 (.IBEX) registrou baixa de 0,28%, a 19.177,70 pontos. Em LISBOA, o índice PSI20 (.PSI20) desvalorizou-se 0,44%, a 9.373,82 pontos.

item.title: Junta Electoral de España inicia procedimiento contra Sánchez
item.description: La Junta Electoral Central (JEC) de España abrió el jueves un expediente disciplinario contra el presidente del gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, por una rueda de prensa el 6 de octubre tras una reunión del Consejo de Ministros para anunciar una nueva ley de vivienda, informó la oficina de prensa del Congreso.
item.dc:creator: Mireia Merino, Emma Pinedo
item.content:encoded: La Junta Electoral Central (JEC) de España abrió el jueves un expediente disciplinario contra el presidente del gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, por una rueda de prensa el 6 de octubre tras una reunión del Consejo de Ministros para anunciar una nueva ley de vivienda, informó la oficina de prensa del Congreso. La JEC solicitó la retirada de las declaraciones de los canales institucionales y exigió al presidente que se abstenga de realizar acciones similares durante el período de campaña. El caso tiene su origen en una denuncia presentada por el Partido Popular (PP), de oposición, que argumentó que Sánchez usó los medios del Gobierno para transmitir mensajes de carácter electoral. El procedimiento se abrió después de que Sánchez convocó a elecciones anticipadas para el 29 de noviembre, tras el rechazo en el Congreso de los Diputados de los decretos sobre vivienda. Este escrutinio plantea dudas sobre la neutralidad institucional durante la campaña, una cuestión que puede avivar los ataques políticos incluso cuando los casos solo concluyen con sanciones administrativas. Las denuncias suelen centrarse en si los cargos públicos usaron su investidura, recursos o actos oficiales para difundir mensajes de campaña tras la convocatoria de elecciones En enero de 2020, la JEC multó a Sánchez con 500 euros (560 dólares) por una entrevista televisiva publicada en la página web del Gobierno. En octubre de 2023, multó a Sánchez con 2.200 euros por una rueda de prensa celebrada en Bruselas durante la campaña del 23 de julio, alegando que había elogiado los logros del Gobierno y criticado a la oposición.

item.title: Empresa israelí usó publicidad en línea en una amplia operación de espionaje, dicen investigadores
item.description: La agencia israelí de publicidad digital Discover-Tech espiaba a los usuarios de Internet a través de una extensa red de anuncios en línea que utilizaba para rastrear a sus objetivos y facilitar la vulneración de sus dispositivos, dijeron el jueves dos grupos de investigación.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter
item.content:encoded: La agencia israelí de publicidad digital Discover-Tech espiaba a los usuarios de Internet a través de una extensa red de anuncios en línea que utilizaba para rastrear a sus objetivos y facilitar la vulneración de sus dispositivos, dijeron el jueves dos grupos de investigación. Sus servicios proporcionaron a la empresa israelí Candiru —una empresa de software espía incluida en la lista negra del Gobierno de Estados Unidos—, así como a otras empresas de vigilancia israelíes, acceso a plataformas publicitarias gestionadas por Google (GOOGL.O) , Comcast (CMCSA.O) , la rusa Yandex y otras, según informes independientes del grupo canadiense de vigilancia cibernética Citizen Lab y de la empresa neoyorquina de seguridad publicitaria Confiant. Los informes muestran cómo el sector de la publicidad en línea, que desde hace tiempo es motivo de preocupación en materia de privacidad, también puede servir de canal para campañas de espionaje a gran escala. "La forma en que funciona hoy en día la publicidad en línea supone una amenaza sistémica para la seguridad", dijo a Reuters Wolfie Christl, investigador sénior de Citizen Lab. "Tanto para los Estados como para el sector privado, la sociedad civil y el resto de la población". Los anuncios en línea de Discover-Tech —a menudo de productos comunes como teléfonos o auriculares— llegaron a más de 120.000 sitios web y 75.000 aplicaciones a través de sus diversas colaboraciones, según Citizen Lab. Los usuarios que visitaban sitios web o utilizaban aplicaciones con los anuncios maliciosos podían ser identificados y rastreados por Discover-Tech, que en ocasiones también intentaba extraer los números de teléfono de algunos usuarios de teléfonos inteligentes, según los investigadores. Bastaba con que los anuncios se cargaran en un sitio web para que se produjera el espionaje. Algunos anuncios se utilizaban para ayudar a instalar el software espía de Candiru en los dispositivos de los usuarios, afirmaron ambos grupos de investigación, aunque Confiant señaló que los anuncios que relacionaba con Candiru representaban una pequeña fracción del volumen total de Discover-Tech. ANUNCIOS MALICIOSOS MOSTRADOS EN CIENTOS DE REDES SENSIBLES Jerome Dangu, cofundador de Confiant, dijo que Discover-Tech emitía al menos 10 millones de anuncios al día en todo el mundo y que los acuerdos de intercambio de datos —denominados "cookie matching"— le permitían rastrear a las personas incluso más allá del alcance de sus anuncios. "Es muy probable que cientos de millones de personas se hayan visto afectadas por Discover-Tech", dijo Dangu. Discover-Tech, fundada en 2020, no respondió a los mensajes dejados a través de su formulario de contacto. Tampoco se obtuvo respuesta a un mensaje de LinkedIn ni a los correos electrónicos enviados a su director ejecutivo, Dekel Boni. Los intentos de Reuters por ponerse en contacto con los propietarios de Candiru tampoco tuvieron éxito. El Departamento de Comercio de Estados Unidos incluyó a Candiru en la lista negra en 2021 por supuestamente suministrar software espía que se utilizó para atacar de forma maliciosa a funcionarios del Gobierno, periodistas, activistas y académicos. Citizen Lab dijo que una potente variante del software espía de Candiru, distribuida a través de los anuncios de Discover-Tech, se había utilizado para comprometer 45 dispositivos Windows en la cadena de televisión qatarí Al Jazeera entre 2024 y 2025, algo que, según el grupo, pudo confirmar gracias a que el grupo mediático había compartido sus registros de red con ellos. En un comunicado, Al Jazeera afirmó que "condena los ataques de software espía dirigidos contra varios miembros de su personal" y que estaba tomando medidas para proteger a sus empleados y sus sistemas. "Los responsables deben rendir cuentas", señaló. Dangu, de Confiant, señaló que los anuncios maliciosos se habían mostrado a usuarios en "cientos de redes de categorías sensibles", entre ellas el Pentágono, la Agencia Internacional de Energía Atómica y la Corte Penal Internacional. También dijo que algunas regiones, como los territorios palestinos, estaban especialmente saturadas de anuncios de la empresa israelí. "Si entras en casi cualquier sitio web de Palestina —cualquiera—, te encuentras con un anuncio de Discover-Tech. Esto les proporciona una visibilidad muy completa de las actividades digitales de todo un país", afirmó. Citizen Lab también señaló que disponía de pruebas similares que demostraban que los anuncios maliciosos se mostraban a personas de las Naciones Unidas, la OTAN, la Comisión Europea y más de una docena de gobiernos nacionales. Otras redes en las que aparecieron los anuncios incluían empresas relacionadas con los chips, como Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Sandisk (SNDK.O) , Broadcom (AVGO.O) y Micron (MU.O) , así como varios medios de comunicación de México, Israel y Europa que no fueron identificados. Además de identificar a Candiru y a otros dos proveedores de vigilancia, Citizen Lab dijo que pudo recabar algunos detalles sobre la posible ubicación de los usuarios de Discover-Tech, ya que la empresa expuso inadvertidamente sus registros de autenticación en Internet, lo que reveló que había personas que iniciaban sesión desde direcciones IP de Israel, Europa y el golfo Pérsico. MEDIDAS ADOPTADAS CONTRA DISCOVER-TECH Discover-Tech se encuentra ahora excluida de parte del mercado de la publicidad en línea. Google dijo en un comunicado que había colaborado con la investigación de Citizen Lab y Confiant y que había expulsado a Discover-Tech de sus plataformas publicitarias "por infringir sistemáticamente nuestras políticas". IAB Europe, la asociación europea para el ecosistema del marketing y la publicidad digitales, dijo en un correo electrónico que Discover-Tech había sido suspendida de su lista de proveedores aprobados a nivel mundial la semana pasada, después de que una auditoría identificara infracciones de las políticas. Beeswax, la filial de tecnología publicitaria de Comcast, eliminó a Discover-Tech de su plataforma "a raíz de actividades recientes", indicó Comcast en un comunicado. Yandex no respondió a los mensajes de Reuters en los que se le solicitaban comentarios. La vigilancia impulsada por la publicidad se considera cada vez más una amenaza para la seguridad nacional. A principios de este año, el Pentágono dijo que había recibido informes según los cuales las fuerzas estadounidenses desplegadas en zonas de guerra habían sido objeto de ataques utilizando datos de localización recopilados por empresas de tecnología publicitaria y corredores de datos. Desde entonces, algunas ramas de las Fuerzas Armadas han desactivado el seguimiento publicitario en determinados dispositivos.

item.title: Bearman ready to step up as team leader at Haas F1, says Komatsu
item.description: Ollie Bearman is ready to step up as leader on the track at Haas next season, the US-owned team's principal Ayao Komatsu said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ollie Bearman is ready to step up as leader on the track at Haas next season, the US-owned team's principal Ayao Komatsu said on Thursday. The Japanese was speaking to reporters after Haas announced [USN:L6N461143 TEXT:"Brazilian rookie Rafael Camara"] as Esteban Ocon's replacement on a multi-year deal from 2027. Frenchman Ocon, a past race winner with Renault-owned Alpine, is leaving at the end of the season and while Bearman has yet to be confirmed, the Ferrari-backed Briton looks sure to stay. "I cannot go into certain contractual details but of course I'd like to continue with Ollie," said Komatsu. "He's an incredible talent and he's shown amazing growth. This year he's shown that he's ready to be a team leader". Bearman, 21, has scored 23 of Haas's 30 points so far from 17 rounds this season. In Singapore last weekend the Briton finished sixth in the Saturday sprint race after starting 13th, on a track where overtaking is extremely difficult. There were nine retirements. "It's just a matter of timing," Komatsu said of Bearman's contract extension. "It's just a matter of finalising certain details. But it is our intention to continue with Ollie. The formal announcement will come in due course." The next race is a home one for Haas, the US Grand Prix at Austin's Circuit of the Americas in Texas next week.

item.title: No breakthrough in talks at Antofagasta's striking Centinela copper mine, unions say
item.description: Negotiations between Antofagasta Minerals and two striking unions at Chile's Centinela copper mine showed no progress on Thursday, while three workers marked their seventh day on a hunger strike.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Negotiations between Antofagasta Minerals and two striking unions at Chile's Centinela copper mine showed no progress on Thursday, while three workers marked their seventh day on a hunger strike. The Distrito Centinela and Minera Esperanza unions, which together represent more than 700 workers, began the [USN:L1N45T0DW TEXT:"walkout on October 7"] after contract talks collapsed. The sides returned to the negotiating table on Tuesday in an effort to resolve the dispute. "So far, after three days of voluntary mediation, the company has refused to address a mechanism to end discrimination during the term of the collective agreement," the unions said in a statement. The unions added that the company was continuing to present a financial offer already rejected by workers, while ignoring what they called the core issue: alleged violations of workers' fundamental rights to equal treatment and non-discrimination. The unions say the dispute centers on alleged disparities in pay and benefits for workers performing similar roles at the mine. Antofagasta said on Wednesday that it had so far managed to [USN:S0N44M02N TEXT:"keep production running"] as planned. On Thursday, the company reported a 7% rise in [USN:L1N46106S TEXT:"third-quarter output"] and maintained its full-year production forecast of 625,000 to 655,000 metric tons of copper. In a statement on Thursday, the firm reaffirmed its willingness to seek an agreement, and said dialogue this week has opened up the possibility to reach a deal. The company said it opposed the use of a hunger strike that could put workers' health and lives at risk. The strike at Centinela — along with the ultimately [USN:L1N4600CR TEXT:"averted risk"] of a supervisors' stoppage at Escondida — has helped support global copper prices, amid concerns of difficulties to expand supply enough to meet expected future demand.

item.title: DOJ sues California to block votes from alleged non-citizens
item.description: The US Justice Department on Thursday sued California, asking a federal judge to block the state from counting mail ballots for the November midterm elections from more than 20,000 voters the Trump administration alleges are likely non-citizens.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Justice Department on Thursday sued California, asking a federal judge to block the state from counting mail ballots for the [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"November midterm elections"] from more than 20,000 voters the Trump administration alleges are likely non-citizens. The lawsuit comes after [USN:L6N46002O TEXT:"Reuters reported"] that the department gave California a 48-hour deadline on Tuesday to review a list of alleged non-citizen voters, provided on a thumb drive, that the department said had been sent mail-in ballots by California. Letters addressed to California Secretary of State Shirley Weber and Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder Dean Logan demanded that the state and county segregate returned mail-in ballots from voters on the Justice Department's list and not tabulate their votes "until citizenship has been determined." In cases where ballots have not been sent out yet, the Justice Department ordered California officials to withhold them from those on the list until their citizenship is confirmed. The lawsuit, filed in US District Court for the Central District of California, seeks a court order preventing California from "tabulating in federal elections vote-by-mail ballots received" from voters on the list, which the DOJ said included more than 20,000 voters, until their immigration status is verified.

item.title: Maduro e esposa se declaram inocentes de acusações de tortura dos EUA
item.description: O presidente deposto da Venezuela Nicolás Maduro e sua esposa, Cilia Flores, se declararam inocentes nesta quinta-feira em relação a uma nova acusação dos EUA de conspirar para torturar oponentes políticos.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen
item.content:encoded: O presidente deposto da Venezuela Nicolás Maduro e sua esposa, Cilia Flores, se declararam inocentes nesta quinta-feira em relação a uma nova acusação dos EUA de conspirar para torturar oponentes políticos. As acusações adicionais, apresentadas na última quinta-feira, ampliaram significativamente o processo criminal dos EUA contra Maduro, de 63 anos, e Flores, de 70. Anteriormente, eles já haviam se declarado inocentes das acusações de terem abusado do poder para ajudar traficantes de drogas a transportar cocaína. Maduro e Flores, capturados pelas Forças Armadas dos EUA em uma operação realizada em janeiro a mando do presidente Donald Trump e transportados de avião para Nova York, apresentaram suas alegações em uma audiência de acusação perante o juiz Alvin Hellerstein, no tribunal federal de Manhattan. Eles vestiam uniformes prisionais bege e estavam algemados pelos tornozelos durante a audiência. Quando Hellerstein perguntou qual seria sua declaração, Maduro disse que as acusações já haviam sido feitas anteriormente e eram falsas. “Eu vi tudo, juiz Hellerstein”, declarou Maduro, referindo-se à acusação. “Rejeito este documento na íntegra.” O juiz interrompeu Maduro enquanto ele falava e disse que uma declaração de inocência seria registrada em seu nome. Flores afirmou: “Sou totalmente inocente. Não sou culpada.” Maduro e Flores não são acusados de terem cometido pessoalmente quaisquer atos de tortura. Cada um deles enfrentaria uma pena mínima obrigatória de 50 anos de prisão caso fosse condenado por todas as acusações. Hellerstein adiou a data de início do julgamento em duas semanas, para 14 de junho de 2027, devido às novas acusações. "APERTEM COM MAIS FORÇA" Promotores do Ministério Público Federal de Manhattan afirmam que Maduro ordenou que autoridades venezuelanas torturassem políticos da oposição e militares acusados de conspirar contra ele para manter o poder no país sul-americano. Em um suposto incidente descrito na acusação, Maduro, em 2014, ordenou que autoridades sequestrassem militares para extrair deles informações sobre possíveis dissidentes e disse às autoridades para “apertá-los com mais força” quando alguns se mantinham desafiadores. Flores concordou com o plano na reunião e rejeitou uma sugestão alternativa de obter informações por meio da infiltração nas fileiras, de acordo com a acusação. As relações entre Maduro, um socialista, e os Estados Unidos foram tensas durante seus 13 anos no poder à frente do país rico em petróleo. Sucessivos governos dos EUA impuseram sanções a autoridades venezuelanas e a importantes empresas estatais, alegando supostas violações de direitos humanos, corrupção e fraude eleitoral. Maduro acusou os Estados Unidos de buscar sua destituição para obter maior controle sobre os recursos naturais do país sul-americano. A campanha de pressão culminou na operação de 3 de janeiro, quando as Forças Armadas dos EUA capturaram Maduro e Flores em sua residência em Caracas e os levaram para os Estados Unidos para responder a acusações de tráfico de dogas anunciadas naquele mesmo dia. Desde então, eles estão detidos no Centro de Detenção Metropolitano, no Brooklyn. A ex-vice-presidente de Maduro, Delcy Rodríguez, lidera a Venezuela desde a captura e intensificou a cooperação com os Estados Unidos. Trump tem destacado a captura de Maduro e a reestruturação das relações com a Venezuela como um importante sucesso da política externa rumo às eleições de meio de mandato de 3 de novembro.

item.title: Alstom to maintain UK's Greater Anglia fleet under 15-year, $1 billion deal
item.description: Alstom said on Thursday it had secured a 15-year extension to maintain Greater Anglia's fleet of Class 720 Aventra trains in Britain, in a contract worth about £800 million ($1.06 billion) that runs into the early 2040s.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Alstom (ALSO.PA) said on Thursday it had secured a 15-year extension to maintain Greater Anglia's fleet of Class 720 Aventra trains in Britain, in a contract worth about £800 million ($1.06 billion) that runs into the early 2040s. The French train maker will maintain 133 five-car electric trains at Greater Anglia's Seven Kings depot, including overhauls, repairs, spares and reliability work. The agreement supports around 100 Alstom jobs. The fleet is owned by Angel Trains and was built at Alstom's Derby site. Alstom said the deal would support work with Greater Anglia and future Great British Railways to improve availability, reliability and passenger service. ($1 = £0.76)

item.title: Infantino apology fails to sway England, Germany over FIFA future
item.description: Gianni Infantino apologised to the FIFA Council on Thursday, but English and German football chiefs said they remained unconvinced he was fit to continue as president of soccer's world governing body.
item.dc:creator: Iain Axon
item.content:encoded: Gianni Infantino apologised to the FIFA Council on Thursday, but English and German football chiefs said they remained unconvinced he was fit to continue as president of soccer's world governing body. Infantino said he had apologised during the closed meeting for mistakes in communicating and consulting over the now-abandoned FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) project, but stressed that it had been only a proposal and “in no way a done deal”. "First of all, I apologised for the mistakes that we made in relation to the communication and consultation process related to the FIFA Forward Enterprise project, which then led to many consequences," Infantino said in a video published by FIFA. "But what is important to remember is that it was a proposal, so in no way a done deal." The FFE plan involved creating a company to run the commercial interests of FIFA competitions, including the World Cup, and selling a minority stake to private investors. Infantino said it was intended to generate additional funding for FIFA’s 211 member associations. While Infantino appeared to retain strong support among African officials, opposition from some of Europe’s most influential football associations remained pronounced. German FA president Bernd Neuendorf called for a "complete restart" at FIFA, saying the governance reforms the organisation needed could not be delivered with Infantino in charge. "The first thing is we need reforms. That's true. And everyone knows that," Neuendorf said. "The old administration has to be reformed, and the whole governance has to be reformed. But I'm pretty clear here in this that this is not possible with Gianni. "So we need a complete restart, I think, a political restart." English FA chair Debbie Hewitt said Infantino needed to provide answers to questions raised by FIFA Council members and warned that failure to do so would make him unfit to remain president. "I think the man has to answer those questions," Hewitt said. "And if he doesn't answer those questions, no, he's not fit to be FIFA president." Neuendorf questioned the extent of Infantino’s apology, saying he believed it related primarily to the failure to consult the council rather than to the FFE project itself. "I didn't have the feeling that this apology was because of the FFE project in total," Neuendorf said. "My impression was it was just because it wasn't brought forward to the council and no one was involved." Neuendorf said council members had learned about the project through the media rather than from FIFA's leadership and that representatives from other confederations had also complained about the lack of consultation. "When it came to the FFE project as such, I have the impression that this still was not included when he apologised," he said. QUESTIONS UNANSWERED Hewitt said Infantino’s apparent regret over not consulting the council strengthened the case for releasing the relevant FFE documents to its members. "You have an obligation. We all have an obligation, a fiduciary responsibility to answer the questions that have been put forward," Hewitt said. "He told us to submit those questions. There were so many of them, and now it's up to him to do that and do that in the open way. "If there's nothing to hide, then share (the FFE documents) with us... if you regret it that deeply, please share it with us." The meeting also dealt with calls for reform at FIFA, but Hewitt said meaningful changes could not be made until members understood how the decisions at the centre of recent controversies had been reached. She cited FFE, the decision to suspend the automatic one-match ban imposed on United States forward Folarin Balogun after his World Cup red card, and the FIFA Peace Prize awarded to US President Donald Trump as issues requiring greater scrutiny. "Unless we understand what happened, either it was a massive failing in governance because it wasn't followed or actually the governance was followed, but there was something else that got to what we all felt in there was the wrong decisions," Hewitt said. "So we must understand what happened in order to be able to review it. Otherwise we're guessing." The criticism, however, was not unanimous. Ahmed Yahya, the president of the Football Federation of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania (FFRIM), defended Infantino, saying his leadership had helped develop football around the world, pointing to increased funding for national associations and the expansion of the World Cup to 48 teams. "We (the African nations) believe Gianni is the right person to continue leading football," Yahya said. Asked whether most people wanted Infantino to remain president, he added: "I'm certain. The majority want Gianni to stay."

item.title: CNN signs multi-year AI partnership with Google
item.description: Skydance's CNN said on Thursday it had agreed to a multi-year partnership with Google to explore how generative AI could help drive audience engagement across the network.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Skydance's (SKYD.N) CNN said on Thursday it had agreed to a multi-year partnership with Google (GOOGL.O) to explore how generative AI could help drive audience engagement across the network. The deal marks the first partnership [USN:L4N45S0XK TEXT:"announced"] since Skydance's merger with Paramount, under CEO David Ellison, who has sought to position the media group as a technology-driven business. As part of the deal, CNN will provide enhanced content rights for experimental features in Google's products. "Google's innovation with generative AI has changed how people discover information and content, and now those tools will help us explore new ways to discover and engage audiences," said Sam Felix, CNN's senior vice president of strategic partnerships and business development. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed. CNN said the deal is in line with its strategy to protect its intellectual property, adding that it has multiple commercial partnerships and ongoing discussions with other industry players. The network operates television, streaming and digital news services worldwide, including CNN International and CNN Originals, as well as a direct-to-consumer subscription service and CNN Newsource.

item.title: GRANOS Soja cae a toca mínimo en siete semanas, cosecha EEUU eclipsa demanda china
item.description: Los futuros de la soja estadounidense cayeron por cuarto día el jueves y tocaron su mínimo en siete semanas, ya que la cosecha en pleno apogeo de lo que se prevé que sea una producción récord en el país contrarrestó el impulso proporcionado por la reactivación de la demanda china, dijeron analistas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los futuros de la soja estadounidense cayeron por cuarto día el jueves y tocaron su mínimo en siete semanas, ya que la cosecha en pleno apogeo de lo que se prevé que sea una producción récord en el país contrarrestó el impulso proporcionado por la reactivación de la demanda china, dijeron analistas. Los futuros del maíz registraron una evolución mixta tras alcanzar la semana pasada su mínimo en dos meses, mientras los operadores evaluaban el avance de la cosecha. En tanto, el trigo subió, ya que los últimos ataques a la navegación en el Mar Negro reforzaron las preocupaciones sobre el suministro mundial. Una reciente racha de clima seco en el Medio Oeste de EEUU ha permitido a los agricultores acelerar la cosecha de los cultivos de verano, y muchos de ellos estaban recolectando soja antes que maíz. Las lluvias ralentizaron el ritmo de los trabajos en el campo en el oeste del Medio Oeste el jueves, pero se esperaba un clima más seco para la próxima semana, según los meteorólogos. Los contratos de soja de noviembre de la Bolsa de Chicago bajaban 8 centavos a 12,6925 dólares el bushel a las 1630 GMT. Los contratos de maíz de diciembre bajaban 0,75 centavos a 4,80 dólares el bushel, manteniéndose dentro de un estrecho rango de cotización tras la caída de la semana pasada, provocada por unas perspectivas de cosecha inesperadamente abundantes del Departamento de Agricultura de EEUU. La soja no se vio afectada por la noticia de nuevas compras de productos estadounidenses por parte de China, ya que el ritmo de compra del principal importador mundial no ha sido tan fuerte como algunos operadores esperaban. Según la Casa Blanca, China acordó comprar 25 millones de toneladas métricas al año durante las recientes negociaciones comerciales, y los datos del Gobierno muestran que el país ha cumplido hasta la fecha aproximadamente la mitad de ese compromiso. "Es positivo ver que están comprando, pero aún no estamos donde deberíamos estar", afirmó Brodrick Schmidt, analista de US Commodities. La molienda de soja en el mercado interno estadounidense del mes pasado también quedó por debajo de las expectativas, según un informe mensual de la Asociación Nacional de Procesadores de Semillas Oleaginosas publicado el jueves, que reveló que la molienda de septiembre se situó en 196,3 millones de bushels, su nivel más bajo en 13 meses. Los futuros de trigo de diciembre en la CBOT subieron 3 centavos 6,7625 dólares el bushel, impulsados por los nuevos ataques a buques de carga en la zona occidental del mar Negro.

item.title: Eni flags shutdown risk at southern Italy refinery due to steelworkers' protest
item.description: A workers' protest linked to the crisis of the former Ilva steelworks in Taranto, southern Italy, continues to block access to Eni's local refinery, the group said on Thursday, warning it could lead to a planned shutdown of the plant.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A workers' protest linked to the crisis of the former Ilva steelworks in Taranto, southern Italy, continues to block access to Eni's local refinery, the group said on Thursday, warning it could lead to a planned shutdown of the plant. Eni said the strike that began on Monday was still blocking logistics flows into and out of the refinery While refinery operations continue normally, Eni said prolonged logistical difficulties could affect staff shift changes and force a reorganisation of activities The shortages of technical gases needed to run the plant could ultimately require a planned shutdown of refinery units, it added More than half of around 300 Enilive service stations in the Taranto region of Apulia are currently without fuel, the group said A previously declared fuel shortage at Bari and Brindisi airports remains in effect, it added The disruptions are also affecting fuel deliveries to essential and public utility services, including firefighters, local public transport operators and rail companies, Eni said

item.title: UBS exploring options abroad in case Swiss rules prove intolerable, sources say
item.description: UBS is working on possible scenarios including shifting its headquarters, or a merger with another bank, if Switzerland introduces new banking rules it deems excessively strict, according to three people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Oliver Hirt
item.content:encoded: UBS is working on possible scenarios including shifting its headquarters, or a merger with another bank, if Switzerland introduces new banking rules it deems excessively strict, according to three people familiar with the matter. Switzerland is crafting new regulation for banks in response to the 2023 collapse of Credit Suisse, and a lower house committee will later this month begin debating rules [USN:L8N45F0DE TEXT:"passed"] in September by the upper house that UBS hinted were intolerable. A group inside the bank is considering the various options, which include drawing up a list of smaller banks in the United States that UBS could potentially buy, and the prospect of the bank being taken over itself, according to the sources. There are no active talks underway, the sources said. UBS, which is closely following how events play out in parliament, said: "We don't comment on speculation or views expressed on such matters." Earlier this year, UBS obtained a US banking licence and is eager to expand its business in the United States. But the rules drafted by the Swiss government are partly designed to reduce the risk taxpayers could face if the bank suffered losses in the United States. People familiar with the bank's thinking say US investment bank Morgan Stanley (MS.N) would be the best theoretical match for UBS. The Swiss bank has repeatedly stated that it is not planning to move and sees great value in its Swiss base. There are notable ties between the leadership of the two banks, as UBS Chairman Colm Kelleher spent many years at Morgan Stanley, eventually rising to one of the top jobs there. Kelleher said last month that UBS might need to [USN:L8N4590WE TEXT:"consider"] its future in Switzerland if the incoming rules were too harsh. Under its overhaul, the Swiss government wants UBS to back its foreign units with 100% Common Equity Tier 1 capital, which could tie up in excess of $20 billion. UBS views this as excessive and harmful to its international competitiveness. The upper house last month trimmed that requirement to 90% CET1 capital, but UBS also regards that as excessively high. At present, the bank needs to 60% capitalise its foreign units but that can be partly met with cheaper capital. Since last year, speculation has swirled around the possibility that UBS could move its base abroad to avoid the tougher regulation, and people familiar with the bank's thinking say it has a duty to shareholders to consider all options. Swiss Finance Minister Karin Keller-Sutter, who has led the charge to introduce tougher banking rules, said last month she felt it was unlikely that UBS would leave its homeland, arguing this would be costly and legally complicated.

item.title: Seguradoras provavelmente não vão cobrir perdas de mercados franceses com ataque hacker
item.description: Supermercados franceses estão enfrentando prejuízos de milhões de euros depois que um ataque digital contra sistemas de refrigeração os obrigou a descartar alimentos estragados e os prejuízos não serão cobertos por seguros, afirmaram seguradoras à Reuters.
item.dc:creator: George Abbott, Elizabeth Howcroft
item.content:encoded: Supermercados franceses estão enfrentando prejuízos de milhões de euros depois que um ataque digital contra sistemas de refrigeração os obrigou a descartar alimentos estragados e os prejuízos não serão cobertos por seguros, afirmaram seguradoras à Reuters. Hackers cuja identidade permanece desconhecida assumiram o controle das unidades de refrigeração de cerca de 350 supermercados franceses na noite de domingo, elevando a temperatura das geladeiras e freezers conectados à internet para 50 graus Celsius (122 graus Fahrenheit). Os custos totais do ataque podem chegar a dezenas de milhões de euros em todo o país, estimou na segunda-feira Thierry Cotillard, presidente da Les Mousquetaires, proprietária da rede de mercados Intermarché. Ele afirmou que os supermercados iniciarão uma batalha judicial para determinar quem é o responsável pelas perdas. O seguro para danos causados por eventos digitais normalmente não cobre perdas físicas decorrentes de ataques, e os pedidos de indenização dos supermercados podem ser prejudicados caso não tenham instalado nos equipamentos alvo dos hackers as atualizações de software mais recentes, disseram quatro corretores de seguros à Reuters. Se um agente estatal for identificado como responsável pelo ataque, isso poderá complicar os pedidos de indenização dos supermercados, pois as apólices para danos eletrônicos normalmente não cobrem atos de guerra, segundo um agente do setor de seguros, que pediu anonimato por não estar autorizado a se pronunciar publicamente. Há anos empresas defendem a adoção da chamada "Internet das Coisas" para conectar diferentes tipos de aparelhos à rede mundial de computadores, alegando que isso traria mais produtividade e economia de custos. Mas isso as expôs a novas ameaças de segurança, agravadas por avanços tecnológicos, incluindo a inteligência artificial. Entre 2020 e 2025, os ataques digitais na França, Alemanha, Itália e Espanha custaram mais de 300 bilhões de euros em perdas econômicas, estima a corretora de seguros Howden. David Molony, chefe da área de riscos digitais da corretora de seguros Aon, disse que recomenda às empresas de alguns setores, incluindo varejo e farmacêutico, uma cobertura específica para mercadorias perecíveis que precisam ser armazenadas em condições físicas rigidamente controladas. “Dada a crescente digitalização da tecnologia operacional e dos sistemas conectados, essa é uma área que as empresas devem analisar cuidadosamente”, disse ele. ATAQUES DIGITAIS, PERDAS FÍSICAS As apólices de seguro para riscos eletrônicos dos supermercados podem cobrir alguns custos, como investigações internas ou a contratação de consultores de relações públicas, mas normalmente excluem perdas físicas. A Intermarché informou à agência de notícias AFP na segunda-feira que seu seguro não cobre esse tipo de incidente. Questionada pela Reuters, a Les Mousquetaires não comentou sobre seus acordos de seguro. Carrefour, Monoprix, Coopérative U e E.Leclerc não se manifestaram. O ataque afetou geladeiras que utilizam software fornecido pela empresa dinamarquesa Danfoss, bem como pela Copeland e pela Dixell, informou a agência francesa de segurança digital. A Danfoss afirmou que muitos dos aparelhos utilizam software desatualizado ou "chegaram ao fim da vida útil e não recebem mais atualizações de software ou de segurança”. A possibilidade de falta de atualização do software afetar o seguro depende dos detalhes do contrato, afirmaram as seguradoras. Normalmente, uma empresa que contrata uma apólice de seguro digital declara sua política em relação às atualizações de software, por exemplo, comprometendo-se a realizar atualizações críticas dentro de um determinado prazo, disse Emma Pleut, chefe da área para a França na WTW. Paul Gooch, vice-chefe de departamento da Tokio Marine Kiln, disse que o software desatualizado, por si só, geralmente não é motivo para rejeitar um pedido de indenização. PRÊMIOS MAIS ALTOS, NOVOS PRODUTOS Os varejistas estão cada vez mais buscando seguros digitais que cubram danos físicos, afirmou Molony, da Aon. Essas apólices já são utilizadas nos setores de energia, carga marítima e defesa. A Aon aconselhou grandes varejistas e outros clientes a contratarem seguros que se estendam a “estoques perecíveis” e, recentemente, negociou “apólices de alto valor”, com grandes valores máximos de indenização, em Londres, incluindo essa cobertura, disse Molony. Ataques digitais recentes contra varejistas no Reino Unido e na França também podem levar a prêmios mais altos, afirmaram as seguradoras. Questionada se os varejistas europeus podem enfrentar preços mais altos de seguro após os ataques, Sydonie Williams, chefe de riscos eletrônicos internacionais da Beazley, disse: “Acredito plenamente que isso possa acontecer.” Gooch, da TMK, disse que espera um maior foco em produtos de seguro que abordem especificamente as perdas físicas decorrentes de ataques. “O recente ataque que afetou sistemas de refrigeração em toda a França deve servir como um alerta para aqueles que subestimam as possíveis consequências físicas de incidentes cibernéticos”, disse ele.

item.title: Video de manifestantes en Francia volteando un remolque fue grabado en 2020
item.description: Un clip de un grupo de manifestantes que vuelca un remolque en las calles de París, Francia, fue grabado en noviembre de 2020 durante una marcha contra la violencia policial y no durante las protestas en el país europeo en 2026, como dicen publicaciones en redes sociales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Un clip de un grupo de manifestantes que vuelca un remolque en las calles de París, Francia, fue grabado en noviembre de 2020 durante una marcha contra la violencia policial y no durante las protestas en el país europeo en 2026, como dicen publicaciones en redes sociales. Estos son los detalles clave: Publicaciones en Facebook identifican el video de un grupo de personas con máscaras y ropa negra que arrastran un remolque hasta volcarlo de lado como parte de las protestas recientes. Desde finales de septiembre estallaron [USN:L8N45Z0NT TEXT:"protestas estudiantiles"] en Francia para exigir mejores [USN:L8N45S08G TEXT:"condiciones"] en las escuelas y la policía ha arrestado a más de [USN:L6N45V0HM TEXT:"6 mil personas"], principalmente menores de edad. Sin embargo, el video fue publicado en X el 28 de noviembre de 2020 por el periodista francés Clément Lanot , quien dijo a Reuters en un correo electrónico que “el video es antiguo”. Reuters geolocalizó el lugar donde fue grabado el clip en un cruce de calles de París. Una señal vial, la fachada de un establecimiento y un semáforo coinciden con una captura de 2020 de Google Street View. Reuters publicó una fotografía el 28 de noviembre de 2020 que muestra una perspectiva similar del momento en que los manifestantes voltearon el remolque . [USN:L1N2IE06T TEXT:"Ese día"] personas enmascaradas y vestidas de negro se enfrentaron con la policía al final de una manifestación contra la violencia policial en París luego de que tres agentes agredieran a un productor musical de origen africano. Después, estas protestas [USN:L8N2IG54Y TEXT:"incluyeron"] el rechazo de una reforma a una ley de seguridad que buscaba penalizar la difusión de material que permitiera la identificación de elementos policiales. Veredicto: Falta contexto. El video corresponde a protestas en París de noviembre de 2020 contra la violencia policial. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: Afghan UN mission reports arbitrary detentions, ill-treatment by Taliban
item.description: The United Nations mission in Afghanistan said on Thursday that Taliban morality police arbitrarily detained hundreds of people and subjected dozens to ill-treatment between July and September, allegations the Taliban rejected.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The United Nations mission in Afghanistan said on Thursday that Taliban morality police arbitrarily detained hundreds of people and subjected dozens to ill-treatment between July and September, allegations the Taliban rejected. The UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) said it documented 443 arbitrary arrests and detentions and 97 cases of ill-treatment by morality police during the three-month period. The incidents were linked to alleged violations of rules on women's hijab, restrictions on beards and hairstyles, compulsory prayer attendance and bans on music, UNAMA said. When the Taliban returned to power [USN:L6N44C00O TEXT:"five years ago"], amid the withdrawal of the US and its allies, they promised to govern more liberally than they had in the late 1990s and early 2000s. But those assurances quickly faltered, human rights groups say, with sweeping restrictions on women and girls. The report also recorded four killings and 14 arbitrary detentions of former Afghan security force members despite a general amnesty announced after the Taliban returned to power in 2021. Taliban spokesperson Zabiullah Mujahid rejected the findings, saying detentions were lawful and accusing UNAMA of conducting propaganda against the government. UNAMA said cross-border incidents killed 13 civilians and injured 20 others during the quarter. It also reported the suspension of several media outlets and said Afghan women remained barred from UN premises.

item.title: Law firm Crowell faces disqualification bid in AI lawsuit
item.description: A fight over attorney loyalties has erupted in a lawsuit over the use of photographs to train AI technology, threatening law firm Crowell & Moring's continued role in the case.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: A fight over attorney loyalties has erupted in a lawsuit over the use of photographs to train AI technology, threatening law firm Crowell & Moring's continued role in the case. Online art gallery DeviantArt asked a federal judge in Los Angeles on Wednesday to disqualify Crowell & Moring from representing automotive photography company Evox in the lawsuit, saying the firm previously advised defendant DeviantArt and its parent company on AI and other matters. DeviantArt said in a court filing that Crowell advised its parent company Wix.com and its subsidiaries from 2022 through 2026 on AI litigation, AI regulation and copyright issues. The company said the firm also advised DeviantArt on its DreamUp AI image-generation service. "Crowell's conflict is substantive, not merely technical," DeviantArt told the court. It said the firm's prior work allowed it to acquire "material confidential information" about the company. Crowell had no immediate comment. Evox and Wix.com did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Washington, DC-based Crowell employs nearly 700 lawyers and is known for its litigation and regulatory work. Evox sued DeviantArt and several AI companies in July, alleging they violated copyright law by using its photographs to train artificial intelligence models. DeviantArt, founded in 2000, operates an online community for artists and offers an AI image-generation service called DreamUp. It is a subsidiary of the Israeli company Wix.com. Crowell advised Wix.com on a range of matters from 2022 until this year, according to DeviantArt, including advice on “core products and intellectual property strategies” related to DreamUp and its launch. In a September letter cited in the filing, Crowell's general counsel said the firm had not performed work for Wix or its subsidiaries since 2024 and had no conflict of interest. DeviantArt counters that Crowell never formally or informally terminated its relationship with Wix.com or any of its subsidiaries, including DeviantArt. The company also argues that “a pause in billable work does not convert a client into a former client.” The case is Evox Productions LLC v. Stability AI et al, US District Court for the Central District of California, No. 2:26-cv-07201-CAS-RAO.
