item.title: ロシアで新たなジェット推進型ドローン発射拠点完成間近か、ウクライナにさらなる脅威
item.description:
Tom Balmforth Edward Carron
[ロンドン １５日 ロイター] - ロシアが、高速で迎撃が困難な「ジェット推進型」ドローン（無人機）の発射拠点をわずか６週間でほぼ完成させたことが、防衛専門家への取材や衛星画像の分析で分かった。ロシアはこの高速ドローンをウクライナへの攻撃に投入し、ウクライナは迎撃に苦戦している。
ロシアはウクライナへの無人機攻撃に少なくとも１１カ所の固定発射拠点を使っており、今回の施設はそこに新たに加わる。場所はロシア南西部のロストフ州。 プラネット・ラボとエアバスが提供した商業衛星画像によれば、８月３１日時点では何もない原野だったが、１０月１４日までに、サッカー場約１２６面分の広さの複合施設に変わっていた。
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tom Balmforth　Edward Carron

[ロンドン １５日 ロイター] - ロシアが、高速で迎撃が困難な「ジェット推進型」ドローン（無人機）の発射拠点をわずか６週間でほぼ完成させたことが、防衛専門家への取材や衛星画像の分析で分かった。ロシアはこの高速ドローンをウクライナへの攻撃に投入し、ウクライナは迎撃に苦戦している。

ロシアはウクライナへの無人機攻撃に少なくとも１１カ所の固定発射拠点を使っており、今回の施設はそこに新たに加わる。場所はロシア南西部のロストフ州。 プラネット・ラボとエアバスが提供した商業衛星画像によれば、８月３１日時点では何もない原野だったが、１０月１４日までに、サッカー場約１２６面分の広さの複合施設に変わっていた。 約３．５キロメートルの場所にはミレロボ空軍基地がある。

建設期間は、ジェット推進型ドローンを使ったウクライナに対する攻撃が急増した時期と重なる。軍事アナリストは、ロシアが無人機の生産をジェット推進型にシフトしていると指摘する。

ジェット推進型ドローンは最高時速６００キロに達する。ウクライナ軍のデータによると、ロシアは夏の３カ月間でこの無人機の使用を約６倍に増やした。最も激しく攻撃されたのはキーウとその周辺地域だった。ウクライナが開発した迎撃用無人機は、旧型無人機を念頭にしたもので太刀打ちできない。ウクライナ政府は今、対策を急いでいる。

民間情報会社ドローンセックの創業者で最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）のマイク・モニク氏によると、施設の西端に最新型のジェット推進型ドローン「ゲラン４」と「ゲラン５」を発射できるレールを置くための台が８基ある。施設は完成が非常に近いように見え、「完全に稼働するまでにはおそらく数週間、もっと早い可能性もある」と述べた。 ロイターの分析では、８基の発射台のうち２基には既にレールが設置され、ほかの２基でもレールの設置が進んでいた。

ドローンセックは、新しい発射拠点は、ミレロボ空軍基地の防空システムの防御範囲（バブル）内とみられ、ウクライナがこの施設を攻撃するのは困難との見方を示した。

item.title: ＡＩで金融システミックリスク、ベアメタル復旧必要＝英中銀副総裁
item.description:
Rae Wee Phoebe Seers
[バンコク／ロンドン １５日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩで金融システミックリスク、ベアメタル復旧必要＝英中銀副総裁 10/15 19:40 配信

ロンドンのイングランド銀行本部、9月16日撮影 REUTERS/Corey Rudy

Rae Wee　Phoebe Seers

[バンコク／ロンドン １５日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁は１５日、深刻なサイバー攻撃を受けた場合の復旧策について、銀行と協力して検討していると明らかにした。

同氏は人工知能（ＡＩ）を使ったサイバー攻撃を防御できると想定することはできないと指摘、ＡＩの進歩は世界の金融インフラに「システミックリスク」をもたらす水準に達したと警告した。

バンコクで開かれた国際金融協会（ＩＩＦ）の年次総会で「サイバー攻撃による侵入を防げると想定するだけでは十分ではない。中核サービスに必要な『ベアメタル復旧』の選択肢を検討する必要がある。金融システム全体を通じて、これを考えなければならない」と述べた。

いわゆる「ベアメタル」システムは、銀行の主要な技術基盤から完全に独立しており、主要システムが侵害された場合に稼働できる。

世界の銀行規制当局は、拡大するＡＩリスクの抑制に向けた取り組みを強化している。ロイターは１３日、英国でも監督当局が大手銀行にベアメタル復旧計画の検討を促していると報じた。

ブリーデン氏は、ＡＩの発展により、大規模で複雑なサイバー攻撃のリスクが高まっていると警告。「サイバーセキュリティーの基本的な対策が、これまで以上に重要になっている」と述べた。

「夜も眠れなくなる懸念は何かと聞かれれば、いつもサイバー問題だと答えている。最も心配しているのは、目覚めた時に、金融システム上極めて重要な銀行の一つや中核インフラの一部が攻撃を受け、まひしていることだ」と語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：ＡＩエージェントの「暴走リスク」現実に、見直し迫られるサイバー保険 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 最終更新: 10/15(木) 19:40 ロイター

item.title: Northern Ireland's Donaldson sentenced to 15 years in jail for child sex offences
item.description: The former leader of Northern Ireland's largest unionist party, Jeffrey Donaldson, was sentenced to 15 years in jail on Thursday for child sex offences that were described by the judge as representing "a catastrophic descent into disgrace".
item.dc:creator: Amanda Ferguson
item.content:encoded: The former leader of Northern Ireland's largest unionist party, Jeffrey Donaldson, was sentenced to 15 years in jail on Thursday for child sex offences that were described by the judge as representing "a catastrophic descent into disgrace". Donaldson [USN:L1N42U0JD TEXT:"was convicted"] in June of one count of rape, 13 counts of indecent assault and four counts of gross indecency against two children between 1985 and 2008 in one of the highest-profile cases in the British-run region in recent times. He was one of Northern Ireland's best-known politicians and its longest-serving lawmaker in the British parliament when he was arrested and charged in March 2024. The 63-year-old stared straight ahead as Judge Paul Ramsey handed down the sentence. Ramsey described the case as "disturbing and disquieting" and assessed Donaldson as having a medium chance of reoffending. Donaldson, who has been in prison awaiting sentence since June, denied all charges and is [USN:L8N43J1N7 TEXT:"seeking to appeal"] against his convictions. Prosecution lawyer Rosemary Walsh told a pre-sentencing hearing last month that one of the victims described the abuse as "the worst moment of her life" and that it had affected all her relationships since. The other victim believed her childhood had been stolen and that she had carried around feelings of "shame" ever since. The victims, neither of whom can be identified for legal reasons, gave evidence during the trial. Ramsey said he was in no doubt whatsoever of the permanent mark left on both victims and that this, the length of abuse and age of the victims, were aggravating factors in the severity of the sentence. He said Donaldson had doubled down on his denials and not offered one word of apology or shame. Donaldson qualifies for an automatic 50% remission of his sentence as the offences were committed before a change in the law that gave judges discretion over what portion is spent in custody, meaning he will spend 7-1/2 years in prison, the Lady Chief Justice's Office of Northern Ireland said. Donaldson immediately stepped down as head of the Democratic Unionist Party, founded by Protestant cleric Ian Paisley at the height of three decades of sectarian bloodshed, which ended after a 1998 peace deal. He was knighted by the late Queen Elizabeth for his political services in 2016 and was central to the negotiation of a key post-Brexit trade deal just two months prior to his arrest. He asked for his knighthood [USN:L8N42W1PI TEXT:"to be renounced"] two days after his conviction. The jury also found that Donaldson's wife, Eleanor, aided and abetted her husband. She has also denied the charges. The court ruled her unfit to stand trial last month, due to mental health issues, meaning she could not face criminal conviction.

item.title: Ataque de drones contra dos petroleros deja siete desaparecidos frente a costa rumana
item.description: Equipos de rescate buscaban el jueves a siete marinos desaparecidos después de que unos drones atacaron dos buques cisterna para productos químicos cerca de la costa rumana del mar Negro, provocando un incendio y suscitando preocupaciones de seguridad en una ruta vital para Ucrania.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Equipos de rescate buscaban el jueves a siete marinos desaparecidos después de que unos drones atacaron dos buques cisterna para productos químicos cerca de la costa rumana del mar Negro, provocando un incendio y suscitando preocupaciones de seguridad en una ruta vital para Ucrania. El presidente rumano, Nicusor Dan, afirmó que los dos buques fueron alcanzados por drones, pero se negó a precisar si Rusia era la responsable. "Dos drones aéreos los alcanzaron", declaró Dan a la prensa en Bruselas antes de una cumbre de líderes de la Unión Europea, y añadió que Rumanía seguía recabando información apenas unas horas después de los ataques. "Habrá una reacción por parte del Estado rumano". Los buques estaban fondeados cerca de la desembocadura del canal de Sulina, que conduce al río Danubio, una importante ruta de exportación usada por Ucrania ante los repetidos ataques rusos contra sus puertos del mar Negro. Uno estaba en aguas territoriales rumanas y el otro, justo fuera. Los tripulantes desaparecidos formaban parte de los 12 marinos a bordo del petrolero Wine Trader, con bandera de San Marino, que fue alcanzado a 13 millas náuticas al sureste del canal, cerca de aguas rumanas. Cinco tripulantes fueron rescatados, según las autoridades rumanas. El segundo buque, el petrolero y químico Yara J, con bandera de Comoras, se incendió tras ser alcanzado a entre 8 y 10 millas al sureste de Sulina, dentro de aguas rumanas, a última hora del miércoles. Todos sus tripulantes estaban a salvo. Estos ataques son los últimos de una serie de ataques contra la navegación mercante en la parte occidental del mar Negro. Al menos otros cinco buques de carga han sido atacados cerca de las costas de Rumanía y de la vecina Bulgaria, miembros de la OTAN, en los últimos diez días, con al menos 23 marineros desaparecidos o fallecidos. Los incidentes ocurrieron fuera de las aguas territoriales de la alianza. El Ministerio del Interior informó de que envió dos helicópteros Black Hawk para la misión de búsqueda y rescate, así como dos buques con personal médico a bordo. "En este momento, el rescate no puede realizarse de forma segura debido al fuerte oleaje", señaló en un comunicado. La OTAN dijo en un comunicado que está en contacto con las autoridades rumanas. NUEVOS ATAQUES Añadió que otros dos buques fueron atacados en el mar Negro: el granelero Sea Destiny, con pabellón de Islas Marshall, que estaba en aguas rumanas, y el petrolero Dania J, con bandera de Tanzania, amarrado en el puerto ucraniano de Izmail, en el Danubio. No se mencionaron víctimas. "La OTAN seguirá colaborando de forma estrecha con nuestros aliados en el mar Negro, ajustando nuestra postura de disuasión y defensa según sea necesario", indicó el secretario general de la OTAN, Mark Rutte, tras reunirse con Dan y el primer ministro búlgaro, Rumen Radev. Rumanía comparte una frontera de 614 kilómetros con Ucrania, gran parte de ella a lo largo del Danubio. Ha denunciado reiteradas incursiones de drones rusos en su espacio aéreo desde el inicio de la invasión de Ucrania por parte de Moscú en 2022. La escalada de ataques contra la navegación en el mar Negro ha agravado la preocupación por las exportaciones de cereales de la región. Los ataques rusos contra los puertos ucranianos del mar Negro han obligado a Kiev a depender más del Danubio y las rutas marítimas cercanas a las costas de Rumanía y Bulgaria. Ucrania, por su parte, ha atacado buques rusos cerca de la desembocadura del río Don, en el mar de Azov. Radev afirmó que los líderes de la UE debatirán una propuesta de moratoria sobre los ataques a buques civiles en el mar Negro. "Consideramos el mar Negro una arteria del suministro mundial de alimentos", dijo la ministra rumana de Relaciones Exteriores, Oana Toiu, en una conferencia de seguridad celebrada en Varsovia esta semana. "Actualmente es, por desgracia, el mar más mortífero si se tiene en cuenta el número de víctimas entre los marineros en los últimos meses. Eso significa que tenemos que aumentar nuestras inversiones en disuasión y defensa", agregó.

item.title: El oro repunta por la debilidad del dólar y la caída de los rendimientos en EEUU
item.description: El oro subió más de un 1% el jueves, para romper una racha de tres sesiones de pérdidas, respaldado por la debilidad del dólar y el descenso de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, mientras que las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal suba las tasas este mes eran moderadas a pesar de que los datos de inflación fueron más altos de lo esperado.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Sinha
item.content:encoded: El oro subió más de un 1% el jueves, para romper una racha de tres sesiones de pérdidas, respaldado por la debilidad del dólar y el descenso de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, mientras que las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal suba las tasas este mes eran moderadas a pesar de que los datos de inflación fueron más altos de lo esperado. El oro al contado ganó un 1,1%, a 4.149 dólares por onza, a las 1636 GMT, tras caer a un mínimo de una semana en la sesión anterior. Los futuros del oro estadounidense para entrega en diciembre avanzaron un 1,5%, a 4.170,10 dólares por onza. El dólar (.DXY) caía un 0,4%, mientras que el rendimiento de referencia de los bonos del Tesoro a 10 años se situaba en un mínimo de tres semanas. "Creo que el mercado ya anticipaba en gran medida los altos datos del índice de precios al productor (IPP), tras las cifras del índice de precios al consumidor (IPC) de ayer (miércoles), que superaron las expectativas", dijo Peter Grant, vicepresidente y estratega sénior de metales en Zaner Metals. "El mercado está empezando a darse cuenta de que la Fed tiene las manos atadas en cierta medida debido a la situación fiscal y de que subir las tasas de interés mucho más supondrá una carga considerable para la economía". Unas tasas de interés más altas hacen que los activos que no generan rendimiento resulten menos atractivos. Los precios al productor de Estados Unidos anotaron en septiembre su mayor subida en cuatro años y medio, en un contexto de aumento de los costos de los bienes y servicios, lo que constituye el más reciente indicio de que la inflación se está traspasando de la energía a otros productos. Los datos se sumaron al informe sobre los precios al consumidor publicado el miércoles, que mostró una aceleración de los precios en septiembre debido al aumento de los costos de la gasolina. Sin embargo, la presidenta de la Fed de San Francisco, Mary Daly, y la vicepresidenta de Supervisión, Michelle Bowman, subrayaron que quizá no sea necesaria una subida inmediata de las tasas, lo que moderó las expectativas de un alza en octubre. Entre otros metales, la plata al contado trepó un 2,3%, a 56,90 dólares por onza; el platino subió un 0,4%, a 1.613,75 dólares; y el paladio sumó un 3,2%, a 1.129,20 dólares la onza.

item.title: TSX rises as lower bond yields offset tech, energy weakness
item.description: Canada's main stock index rose on Thursday, as lower bond yields boosted risk appetite, offsetting weakness in energy shares caused by falling oil prices and a global selloff in AI-related technology stocks.
item.dc:creator: Utkarsh Hathi
item.content:encoded: Canada's main stock index rose on Thursday, as lower bond yields boosted risk appetite, offsetting weakness in energy shares caused by falling oil prices and a [USN:L1N4610FG TEXT:"global selloff "]in AI-related technology stocks. The S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) was up 0.52% at 35,770 points by 10:41 a.m. ET, rebounding after sharp declines in the previous session. Canada's benchmark 10-year bond yield slipped about 8 basis points to 3.795%, driving broad sectoral gains Materials sector (.GSPTTMT) , including metal miners, gained 1.4% as precious metal prices rebounded on a softer dollar Chip stocks globally extended losses as concerns about increased borrowing costs unsettled investors, dragging Wall Street's Nasdaq down 0.7% Canadian tech equities (.SPTTTK) declined 0.7%, with e-commerce platform Shopify (SHOP.TO) slipping 1.4% and electronics equipment firm Celestica (CLS.TO) down 7.7% "The sector has continued to be under pressure that started at the beginning of the year, except (for) the relief rally in the spring and summer," said Shiraz Ahmed, CEO of Sartorial Wealth "The moat around their (software) business is not quite as strong, now that AI and the ability to effectively recreate software has become very commoditized" Energy sector (.SPTTEN) slipped 0.5% as oil prices eased 0.7% after a US official on Wednesday signaled potential US steps to ease restriction on Russia's "shadow fleet" tankers Canadian [USN:AQN2MO654 TEXT:"factory sales"] grew 1.5% in August from July on higher sales of primary metals, data showed on Thursday Still, economists remain cautious about recovery in manufacturing considering limited sectoral gains "This reinforces our view that the Bank of Canada will deliver only two of the roughly four rate hikes currently priced in by markets, with tightening serving more as a risk-management exercise against upside inflation risks," said Thomas Ryan, senior North America economist, Capital Economics

FAST

BENGALURU, Oct 15 : Wipro's quarterly deal bookings plunged to an almost four-year low, deepening worries that India's fourth-largest IT firm is ceding market share to rivals. Thursday's news dragged down the company's US-listed shares 4.5 per cent in premarket trading and highlighted CEO Srinivas Pallia's struggle to revive growth more than two years after taking the helm. "Wipro is still not out of the woods, and this will persist," Indsec Securities analyst Rishubh Vasa said, highlighting how the firm's ability to win new business has weakened over the past two to three quarters. "Their order book is in stress." AI has disrupted India's $315 billion IT industry, forcing firms to revamp business models and offer deep discounts to win deals. Wipro, meanwhile, has also struggled with top-level exits and acquisition-related challenges.

The company's total contract value bookings plunged to $2.6 billion in the quarter ended September 30 from $4.7 billion a year earlier. Underscoring Wipro's need to bag large deals, Pareekh Jain, founder of IT research firm EIIR Trend, said its "dual focus on margin and revenue is not working." While Cognizant has been gaining ground with aggressive pricing and Tech Mahindra has revived margins after exiting low-yield accounts, Wipro is still trailing the pack, Jain added. DEMAND WOES Wipro forecast third-quarter revenue of $2.57 billion to $2.63 billion, implying a roughly 1.5 per cent decline to 0.5 per cent growth. That was modestly ahead of analysts' expectations for revenue to decline up to 2 per cent or remain flat. Seasonal furloughs would weigh on third-quarter performance, Pallia said. Consolidated second-quarter revenue rose 9.1 per cent to 247.53 billion rupees ($2.60 billion), edging past analysts' average estimate of 246.27 billion rupees, according to LSEG data. Net profit, hurt by higher wage and subcontracting costs, fell 1.5 per cent to 32.01 billion rupees, below expectations of 33.69 billion rupees. ($1 = 95.0550 Indian rupees)

item.title: Trump donor leading Caucasus fund has major Armenia holdings, Russia business history
item.description: US President Donald Trump’s pick to lead a $201 million investment fund in the Caucasus holds major telecom and mining interests there and formerly ran a Russia-focused investment firm that touted close ties to the Kremlin, documents reviewed by Reuters show.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Landay, Alexandra Ulmer, Maria Tsvetkova
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump’s pick to lead a $201 million investment fund in the Caucasus holds major telecom and mining interests there and formerly ran a Russia-focused investment firm that touted close ties to the Kremlin, documents reviewed by Reuters show. Konstantin Sokolov, a 51-year-old Russian-born businessman, was put in charge of the investment vehicle, now called the Trans-Caspian Enterprise Fund, in January, according to its incorporation documents. He holds major stakes in Armenia’s top mobile phone company Viva Armenia, and purchased Armenia’s second largest copper and molybdenum mine earlier this year after receiving a special permit from the US government to buy it, according to the Reuters reporting. A Reuters review of public documents related to the only three other US enterprise funds now operating showed no indications that any of their heads have major investments in the countries where those funds invest. Bo Cutter, chairman of a US enterprise fund focused on Tunisia told Reuters he had "no business interests of any kind in Tunisia," without elaborating on whether and why that might pose a problem. Cutter declined to comment on Sokolov or the Trans-Caspian fund. Still, according to six ethics experts who reviewed the Reuters reporting, Sokolov’s business interests create a conflict of interest because his role gives him control of government money that could potentially benefit his companies. Ann Skeet, an ethics expert at Santa Clara University, said, "I think Congress should be asking questions." Reuters found no indication of any wrongdoing by Sokolov. US legislation governing such investment funds does not forbid directors from holding investments in regions of operation. A representative for Sokolov’s private equity firm, IJS Investments, said the fund was prohibited from investing in any of his businesses and that Sokolov had complied with "all due diligence and security requirements." A State Department spokesperson said the enterprise fund would comply with annual reporting requirements and independent audits "as well as with applicable grant provisions including conflict of interest requirements." Sokolov had been among a list of 37 corporate and individual donors to Trump’s White House ballroom project distributed by the White House last year. The Washington Post reported on Thursday that Sokolov donated $1 million to the project. Sokolov has also donated some $13 million to Republican political groups, according to Federal Election Commission data. ASCENDANT IN ARMENIA The Trans-Caspian fund is part of a broader US push to develop trade routes and investment across the South Caucasus and Central Asia, an effort that could reduce the region's reliance on Russian and Chinese infrastructure. The Trans-Caspian fund’s board, led by Sokolov, has the power to make grants, loans and investments across Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan. Its website lists critical minerals, energy and rail infrastructure among its top investment priorities. Sokolov has built up his business presence in Armenia rapidly in recent years. He and a Chinese business partner, Zhe Zhang, acquired control of Viva Armenia in January 2024 from Russia's largest mobile provider, MTS, according to company statements and Armenian corporate records. Zhang, a former Chinese Commerce Ministry diplomat, did not respond to requests for comment. Viva Armenia did not comment. More recently, Sokolov’s Texas-based Dynamic Frontier Holdings company said it was granted legal authorization from the US Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control on June 1 to buy Armenia’s Teghout mine from a sanctioned state-owned Russian bank, VTB. OFAC licenses authorize transactions that would otherwise be prohibited by US sanctions and typically take several months or years to process. Sokolov and a representative for the Teghout mine did not respond to questions about when they first applied for a license. A representative for Teghout said licenses and approvals for the transaction were obtained through OFAC’s "standard independent regulatory process." The US Treasury Department and VTB did not respond to requests for comment. None of the heads of the only other active US enterprise funds - which focus on Egypt, Tunisia, and Ukraine-Moldova - appear to have significant business interests in those countries, according to a Reuters review of public documents and their official biographies. James Harmon is chairman of the Egyptian fund, and Dennis Johnson is chairman of the Ukraine-Moldova fund. They did not respond to requests for comment. BACKGROUND IN RUSSIA Sokolov’s biography on his personal website highlights his modest upbringing in St. Petersburg and his dislike of the Soviet government, which he said sent his grandmother to a gulag. It says he immigrated to the United States at 21, several years after the collapse of the Soviet Union. But his ties to Russia went on long after he left, according to a Reuters review of corporate and government records. The businessman’s purported ties to the Russian government warrant scrutiny to ensure US interests come first in the fund’s management, said two of the ethics experts Reuters interviewed. "I'd want a very thorough security clearance review if I were in the US government," said Richard Painter, a University of Minnesota professor who served as ethics counsel to former Republican President George W. Bush. A 2015 promotional brochure reviewed by Reuters for the now-defunct Liechtenstein-registered Gotthard Investment Fund, a Russia-focused real estate investment operation, listed Sokolov as a fund manager and emphasized the fund’s "strong and long-lasting personal and professional trust relationships forged over the last 20 years with Moscow, St. Petersburg and Federal governments." A former project manager with the fund, speaking to Reuters on condition of anonymity, said they recognized the brochure as authentic. Lawyers representing Sokolov said that Sokolov "does not believe" the brochure is authentic, and that the logo on the brochure did not appear to be one used by the fund. "Mr. Sokolov has no relationships with Russian government officials or the Russian government," his representative told Reuters, adding "he does not hold a Russian citizenship." Reuters could not independently confirm Sokolov no longer has Russian citizenship. Sokolov used a Russian passport for international travel as late as 2016, according to travel records reviewed by Reuters. The White House referred requests for comment about Sokolov to the State Department. The State Department did not provide details on Sokolov’s background check or whether he had a security clearance. When asked for comment about Sokolov, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said: "We don’t know who you are talking about."

item.title: UK's FTSE 100 closes at seven-week high on fiscal reassurance, defensive buying
item.description: London's blue-chip stocks closed at a seven-week high on Thursday after the finance minister reaffirmed the government's commitment to fiscal discipline, while a shift into defensive sectors amid a deepening global selloff in AI-related stocks also supported the benchmark.
item.dc:creator: Darshan R
item.content:encoded: London's blue-chip stocks closed at a seven-week high on Thursday after the finance minister [USN:S8N4040BJ TEXT:"reaffirmed"] the government's commitment to fiscal discipline, while a shift into defensive sectors amid a deepening global selloff in AI-related stocks also supported the benchmark. The benchmark FTSE 100 index (.FTSE) closed higher by 1.1% to 10,840.35 points, its highest since August 26, while the midcap FTSE 250 (.FTMC) also rose 0.26%. Investors sought refuge in defensive sectors as a global chip stocks selloff intensified, benefiting UK's large caps with limited exposure to AI "It's a rotation towards long-term; almost an infrastructure play without the risk of a rate increase and healthcare, consumer cyclicals are a safer heaven as they are not overly leveraged," said Nick Saunders, CEO of Webull UK Drugmakers AstraZeneca (AZN.L) and GSK (GSK.L) climbed 3.2% and 2.9%, respectively Dove soap maker Unilever (ULVR.L) rose 1.8% and cigarette maker British American Tobacco (BATS.L) advanced 2.5% British finance minister John Healey said this month's budget would aim at bolstering economic resilience, adding that he and Prime Minister Andy Burnham were aligned on maintaining fiscal discipline Financials (.FTNMX301010) , including heavily weighted banks, was up 0.3% UK's [USN:L8N4610AT TEXT:"gross domestic product"] rose 0.1% in August, boosted by AI optimism, against expectations of a 0.1% drop Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill said that any [USN:L1N461041 TEXT:"future interest rate increase"] should not be interpreted by investors as the start of a prolonged series of rate hikes [USN:L6N4600XN TEXT:"Economists polled"] by Reuters expect the BoE to raise rates to 4% in November Industrial metal miners (.FTNMX551020) were down 1.4%, on weaker copper prices Antofagasta (ANTO.L) fell 4.1%, after the Chilean miner's third-quarter [USN:L1N46106S TEXT:"copper production"] declined year-on-year E-commerce group THG (THG.L) surged 16.3% after lifting its annual profit forecast Paper and packaging firm Mondi (MNDI.L) slumped 7.9% after hiking prices for several paper grades to offset higher energy costs

item.title: Wall St banks caught in capital markets lull after a strong first half of 2026
item.description: Quarterly results from Wall Street's big banks this week showed that even the largest and most robust players of the industry can be vulnerable to the ebb and flow of capital markets.
item.dc:creator: Manya Saini
item.content:encoded: Quarterly results from Wall Street's big banks [USN:L1N45Z0O3 TEXT:"this week showed"] that even the largest and most robust players of the industry can be vulnerable to the ebb and flow of capital markets. Dealmaking, a cyclical business, slowed in the third quarter and dented investment banking, as rising bond yields, choppy AI trade and geopolitical worries gave jitters to investors and corporate boardrooms alike, [USN:L6N45M0VD TEXT:"further delaying"] a long-awaited revival in M&As and IPOs. Here is an overview of results from the six top US banks in charts, which kicked off the third-quarter earnings season for US companies: TWO MISSES, LITTLE MARKET CHEER JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) posted its [USN:L4N45Z10B TEXT:"first profit miss"] since the fourth quarter of 2023, according to LSEG data, while its closest rival, Bank of America (BAC.N) , [USN:L4N4600XY TEXT:"fell short"] of market expectations. The other four top US banks exceeded expectations, but their stocks traded lower or did not react as investors judged the earnings beats to be smaller than in previous quarters. DEALMAKING STALLS Dealmakers were looking forward to a bumper year, but momentum has stalled since the summer as market volatility, geopolitical turmoil, rising Treasury yields and concerns over the sustainability of the AI trade kept companies on the sidelines. Growth in investment banking fees slowed sharply compared to the prior quarter as an interest-rate hike and delays to several high-profile IPOs hit sentiment, even though executives reassured investors that they have not been canceled. EQUITY AND FIXED-INCOME DESKS DIVERGE The quarterly results revealed a sharp divide in trading performance at big banks: equity desks benefited from a surge in market activity, while fixed-income underperformed. Market volatility typically boosts trading businesses as clients reposition portfolios and hedge against risks. CONSUMER BANKING: A STEADY ENGINE Net interest income, the difference between what banks earn on loans and pay out on deposits, rose, with analysts expecting further support from the Federal Reserve's September rate hike. Banking executives [USN:L4N45V0N5 TEXT:"pointed to resilient consumer spending"] and borrowing, easing concerns that sticky inflation and elevated rates would strain household budgets. In a bright spot, loan demand also continued to chug along. BANKING INDEX VS S&P 500 Here is a rundown of Reuters' coverage of the six largest U.S. banks: JPMorgan [USN:L4N45Z10B TEXT:"posts rare profit miss"] as dealmaking, bond trading lose momentum Goldman Sachs [USN:L4N45Z111 TEXT:"beats quarterly profit estimates"] on equities strength Wells Fargo [USN:L4N45Z0VX TEXT:"beats profit estimates"], but net interest income, revenue fall short Citi [USN:L4N45Z14U TEXT:"profit tops estimates"] on higher investment banking, services and wealth revenue Morgan Stanley [USN:L4N46010U TEXT:"beats quarterly profit estimates"] as stock trading desks shine BofA [USN:L4N4600XY TEXT:"misses profit estimates"] on capital market weakness; books $1.2 billion charge

item.title: Israeli firm used online ads to run vast spy operation, researchers say
item.description: Israeli digital advertising agency Discover-Tech spied on internet users through a sprawling network of online ads that it used to track targets and help hack their devices, two research groups said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter
item.content:encoded: Israeli digital advertising agency Discover-Tech spied on internet users through a sprawling network of online ads that it used to track targets and help hack their devices, two research groups said on Thursday. Its services gave Israel's Candiru — a spyware company [USN:L1N2RU186 TEXT:"blacklisted by the US government"] — as well as other Israeli surveillance firms access to advertising platforms run by Google (GOOGL.O) , Comcast (CMCSA.O) , Russia's Yandex and others, according to separate reports from Canadian cyber watchdog group Citizen Lab and New York advertising security firm Confiant. The reports show how the online advertising business, long a subject of privacy concerns, can also serve as a channel for sweeping espionage campaigns. "The way online advertising works today is a systemic security threat," Wolfie Christl, a senior researcher at Citizen Lab, told Reuters. "For states, the private sector, civil society and everyone else alike." Discover-Tech's online ads — often for ordinary products such as phones or earbuds — reached more than 120,000 websites and 75,000 apps through its various partnerships, Citizen Lab said. Users who visited sites or used apps with the malicious ads could be identified and tracked by Discover-Tech, which would sometimes also try to extract phone numbers from some smartphone users, the researchers said. Ads only needed to load on a website for the spying to occur. Some ads would be used to help plant spyware from Candiru on users' devices, both research groups said, though Confiant said that ads it tied to Candiru were a tiny fraction of Discover-Tech's overall volume. MALICIOUS ADS SHOWN IN HUNDREDS OF SENSITIVE NETWORKS Confiant cofounder Jerome Dangu said Discover-Tech was pumping out at least 10 million ads per day all around the world and that data-sharing arrangements — called cookie matching — allowed it to track people even beyond the reach of its advertisements. "Very likely hundreds of millions of people would have been touched by Discover-Tech," Dangu said. Discover-Tech, which was founded in 2020, did not return messages left via its contact form. A LinkedIn message and emails sent to its chief executive, Dekel Boni, were not returned. Reuters' attempts to reach Candiru's owners were similarly unsuccessful. The US Commerce Department blacklisted Candiru in 2021 for [USN:L1N2RU186 TEXT:"allegedly supplying spyware"] that was used to maliciously target government officials, journalists, activists and academics. Citizen Lab said a powerful form of Candiru spyware delivered through Discover-Tech's ads had been used to compromise 45 Windows devices at the Qatari broadcaster Al Jazeera between 2024 and 2025, something it said it was able to confirm because the media group had shared its network logs with the group. In a statement, Al Jazeera said it "condemns the spyware attacks targeting a number of its staff" and that it was taking steps to protect its employees and its systems. "Those responsible must be held accountable," it said. Dangu of Confiant said that the malicious ads had been shown to users in "hundreds of networks in sensitive categories," including the Pentagon, the International Atomic Energy Agency, and the International Criminal Court. He also said that some regions, like the Palestinian territories, were particularly saturated by the Israeli firm's ads. "You go to almost any site in Palestine — any site — you find a Discover-Tech ad. It gives them a very complete visibility on the digital activities of an entire country," he said. Citizen Lab also said it had similar evidence showing the malicious ads were shown to people in the United Nations, NATO, the European Commission, and more than a dozen national governments. Other networks the ads appeared in included chip-related firms such as Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Sandisk (SNDK.O) , Broadcom (AVGO.O) , and Micron (MU.O) , as well as several media organizations in Mexico, Israel, and Europe that were not identified. In addition to identifying Candiru and a couple of other surveillance vendors, Citizen Lab said it was able to glean some details about where Discover-Tech's users might be based because the firm inadvertently exposed its authentication logs to the internet, showing people logging in from internet protocol addresses in Israel, Europe, and the Gulf. MEASURES AGAINST DISCOVER-TECH TAKEN Discover-Tech is now being frozen out of parts of the online ad market. Google said in a statement that it had collaborated with Citizen Lab and Confiant's investigation and kicked Discover-Tech off its ad platforms "for systematically violating our policies." IAB Europe, the European-level association for the digital marketing and advertising ecosystem, said in an email that Discover-Tech had been suspended from its list of globally approved vendors last week after an audit identified policy violations. Comcast ad tech subsidiary Beeswax removed Discover-Tech from its platform "following recent activity," Comcast said in a statement. Yandex did not return Reuters messages seeking comment. Advertising-driven surveillance is increasingly being seen as a national security threat. Earlier this year, the Pentagon said it had received reports that US forces deployed to war zones had been [USN:L6N4240BC TEXT:"targeted using location data"] harvested by ad tech firms and data brokers. Branches of the military have since [USN:L6N44V02G TEXT:"disabled ad tracking"] on some devices.

item.title: ルーマニア領海でタンカー2隻火災、乗組員7人が行方不明
item.description: ［ブカレスト １５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ブカレスト　１５日　ロイター］ - ルーマニア当局は１５日、黒海の同国領海内で炎上した化学品タンカーについて、救助隊が行方不明の乗組員７人を捜索していると発表した。

火災に先立ち、ロシアの無人機（ドローン）がルーマニア領空に侵入していた。ルーマニア当局は、船舶火災とロシアの無人機との関連を明言していない。

前日夜に火災が起きた２隻のタンカーはともに、黒海からドナウ川へ通じる運河の河口付近に停泊していた。ロシアがウクライナの黒海沿岸の港を爆撃しているため、ウクライナはドナウ川の港や、ブルガリアとルーマニアの沿岸に近い航路への依存を強めている。

ルーマニアの海事当局は、サンマリノ船籍のタンカー「ワイン・トレーダー」から緊急通報を受けたと明らかにした。乗組員１２人のうち５人が救助され、７人が行方不明となっている。

内務省は捜索・救助活動にブラックホーク・ヘリコプター２機と、医療スタッフを乗せた船舶２隻を派遣したと発表した。声明で「波が非常に高く、現時点では安全に救助活動を行えない」と説明した。

コモロ船籍の化学品・石油タンカー「ヤラＪ」でも火災が発生したが、乗組員は全員無事だった。ルーマニア当局は当初、攻撃を受けたかどうかは不明としていた。

ここ数カ月、ロシアとウクライナの戦争に関連した黒海での船舶攻撃が増加し、世界的な食料危機を招く恐れが出ている。ブルガリアのラデフ首相は、欧州連合（ＥＵ）首脳が１５日、黒海での民間船舶への攻撃を一時停止する案を協議すると述べた。

item.description: LONDON, Oct 15 : AstraZeneca has teamed up with artificial intelligence biotech company insitro to discover and develop new treatments for difficult to treat liver and heart conditions, the British drugmaker said on Thursday.Under the agreement, AstraZeneca will pay $40 million up front, with California-based

FAST

LONDON, Oct 15 : AstraZeneca has teamed up with artificial intelligence biotech company insitro to discover and develop new treatments for difficult to treat liver and heart conditions, the British drugmaker said on Thursday. Under the agreement, AstraZeneca will pay $40 million up front, with California-based insitro eligible for up to about $1.46 billion in potential development and commercial milestones, as well as a single-digit percentage of future sales in royalties. The multi-year collaboration will focus on metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), a severe liver disease, and cardiomyopathies, a group of diseases that affect the heart muscle. Both have historically lacked effective therapies because researchers have struggled to pinpoint their root biological drivers, the drugmaker said. Insitro will use its "Virtual Human" AI platform, which combines lab-grown cell models and machine learning, to identify causal disease biology and advance AstraZeneca-nominated targets from discovery to development-candidate stage. AstraZeneca will then run and fund future clinical trials.

The deal builds on insitro's expansion across the pharmaceuticals industry. The biotech company recently expanded its partnership with Bristol Myers Squibb to advance a broader portfolio of targets for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). It also teamed up with Eli Lilly to build AI models that predict pharmacological properties of small molecules in living organisms. "Choosing the new targets that we want to put into our discovery pipeline is one of the hardest things we do across research and development," Sharon Barr, executive vice president of biopharmaceuticals R&D at AstraZeneca, told Reuters. "By the time we read about a new pathway or target (in major scientific journals), it is no longer novel. It's in the public domain and we're already a few steps too late. But when we identify these unique connections early and test them in cellular systems, we're ahead of the game." Barr added that pairing AI tools with experienced scientists allows the company to test fewer molecules in the lab, reduce guesswork and speed the search for effective medicines.

item.title: Venezuela's Maduro and wife plead not guilty to US torture charges
item.description: Ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores pleaded not guilty on Thursday to a new US indictment accusing them of conspiring to torture political opponents.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen
item.content:encoded: Ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores pleaded not guilty on Thursday to a new US indictment accusing them of [USN:L6N45U13M TEXT:"conspiring to torture"] political opponents. The additional charges, brought last Thursday, significantly expanded the US criminal case against Maduro, 63, and Flores, 70. They previously pleaded not guilty to charges that they abused their power to [USN:L1N40E0K5 TEXT:"help drug traffickers"] ship cocaine. Maduro and Flores, captured by the US military in a January raid ordered by President Donald Trump and flown to New York, entered their pleas at an arraignment before US District Judge Alvin Hellerstein in Manhattan federal court. They wore tan prison garb and were shackled at the ankles during the hearing. When Hellerstein asked for his plea, Maduro said the accusations had been made previously and were false. "I have seen it in its entirety, Judge Hellerstein," Maduro said, referring to the indictment. "I reject this document in its entirety." The judge cut Maduro off as he spoke and said a plea of not guilty would be entered on his behalf. Flores said, "I am completely innocent. I am not guilty." Maduro and Flores are not accused of personally carrying out any acts of torture. They would each face a mandatory minimum sentence of 50 years in prison if convicted on all charges. Hellerstein postponed the trial start date by two weeks to June 14, 2027, due to the new charges. 'SQUEEZE THEM HARDER' Prosecutors with the Manhattan US Attorney's office say Maduro directed Venezuelan officials to torture opposition politicians and military personnel accused of plotting against him to maintain power in the South American country. In one alleged incident described in the indictment, Maduro in 2014 directed officials to kidnap military personnel to draw information out of them about possible dissidents, and told officials to "squeeze them harder" when some remained defiant. Flores agreed with the plan in the meeting, and dismissed a suggested alternative plan to glean information by infiltrating the ranks, according to the indictment. Relations between Maduro, a socialist, and the United States were tense during his 13 years in power leading the oil-rich country. Successive US administrations imposed sanctions on top Venezuelan officials and key state companies, citing alleged human rights violations, corruption and election-rigging. Maduro accused the United States of seeking his ouster to gain greater control of the South American country's natural resources. CAPTURED AT HOME The pressure campaign culminated in the January 3 raid, when the US military captured Maduro and Flores at their Caracas home and brought them to the United States to face drug trafficking charges announced that same day. Since then, they have been held at the Metropolitan Detention Center in Brooklyn. Maduro's former vice president, Delcy Rodriguez, has led Venezuela since his capture and has ramped up cooperation with the United States. Trump has touted Maduro's capture and the reset of relations with Venezuela as a key foreign policy success heading into the November 3 midterm elections in which his fellow Republicans are fighting to retain control of Congress.

item.title: UK's Healey says banks are key to economy but keeps tax options open
item.description: British finance minister John Healey said banks were central to the country's economic future on Thursday when pressed by reporters about the likelihood of a windfall tax on their bumper profits in his first budget on October 28.
item.dc:creator: David Milliken
item.content:encoded: British finance minister John Healey said banks were central to the country's economic future on Thursday when pressed by reporters about the likelihood of a windfall tax on their bumper profits in his first budget on October 28. Increasing the 3% surcharge for banks on top of standard corporation tax could raise billions of pounds at a time when many lenders have profited from rising interest rates. However, banks argue they are already highly taxed in Britain compared with some other major financial centres and some analysts say higher bank taxes would see them put up charges. "My observation on the banks is that people too often see them as big, distant financial institutions, when they are hardwired into the economic fabric of this country and our future prospects," Healey told reporters in Bangkok, where he is attending the International Monetary Fund's annual meeting. "That said, I've got decisions to take in the budget and I will," he added, noting that his comments were not intended to be a steer on any intended tax changes. Following Healey's remarks, the Guardian newspaper reported that it understood the finance minister was [USN:SPN46001Q TEXT:"poised to tax banks"] in his budget. The report said reversing cuts to the bank surcharge would be a possible option considered by Healey, but did not say whether a final decision had been made. MANY BANKING ANALYSTS HAVE PENCILLED IN TAX RISE Analysts covering British banks have in recent weeks suggested an increase in the surcharge that banks pay on their profits is likely, with both a return to the previous 8% level and a smaller rise of 2-3 percentage points seen as options. The surcharge currently raises just over £1 billion ($1.3 billion) a year. However, bank bosses have grown more confident that they will avoid such increases. The chief executives of two British lenders told Reuters in recent weeks they did not expect any increase after arguing that such a tax hike could curb lending. Trade body UK Finance said in response to Healey's comments that an increase in bank taxes "would weaken the UK's competitiveness, discourage investment and job creation, and work against the government's ambition to deliver growth". In an interview with Bloomberg Television, Healey described banks as "a part of the jewel ... in the British economic crown". When asked if higher taxes on banks could be offset by lower capital requirements, he said he would not be drawn into budget speculation. UK MAY NEED HIGHER TAXES TO KEEP DEFICIT REDUCTION ON TRACK This week, the IMF singled out Britain for praise among major advanced economies for starting a process of deficit reduction that aims at balancing non-investment spending with tax revenue by the 2029/30 tax year. Previous governments have struggled to meet similar rules, due to economic shocks and setting only medium-term goals. Healey told reporters on Thursday that he intended to "stay the path" on deficit reduction in his first budget, when higher inflation and a global rise in interest rates are likely to narrow the margin he has for hitting his goals. "I've said from day one and week one – and I have (Prime Minister) Andy Burnham in lockstep alongside me – I will meet those fiscal rules," he said. "I want the budget to be a budget that gives a bit of breathing space but also reinforces the strength of our fiscal plans," Healey added. British government borrowing costs last week hit their highest since 1998 and are greater than in any other major advanced economy. ($1 = 0.7545 pounds)

A cargo ship is pictured in the Black Sea in Krapets, on Oct 14, 2026, a day after suspected Russian drones struck two cargo ships off Bulgaria, sinking one vessel and leaving 11 sailors missing in the latest spillover from the Ukraine war in the Black Sea. (Photo: AFP/Nikolay Doychinov)

FAST

BUCHAREST: Rescuers were searching for seven missing crew on Thursday (Oct 15) from one of two chemical tankers that caught fire overnight inside Romanian territorial waters in the Black Sea, after Russian drones strayed into Romanian airspace, Romanian officials said. Romanian officials stopped short of explicitly linking the fires onboard the ships to the Russian drones. But the incidents follow drone strikes on at least five other cargo ships near the coasts of Romania and neighbouring fellow NATO member Bulgaria over the past 10 days. At least 23 sailors were lost from those strikes, which unlike the latest incidents took place just outside NATO's territorial waters. The two ships hit overnight were both anchored in the Black Sea near the mouth of the canal leading into the Danube River, a major shipping route used by Ukraine as Russia has attacked Ukraine's own Black Sea ports. Romania's naval authority said it received an emergency alert from the San Marino-flagged tanker Wine Trader. Seven of its 12 crew were missing and 5 were rescued.

The interior ministry said it had sent two Black Hawk helicopters to the search and rescue mission, as well as two ships with medical staff on board. "At the moment, the rescue cannot be done safely because of very big waves," it said in a statement. Late on Wednesday, the Comoros-flagged chemical and oil tanker Yara J also caught fire. Romanian authorities initially said it was not clear whether it had been attacked. All its crew were safe. Romania shares a 614km border with Ukraine, much of it along the Danube. It has reported repeated breaches of its airspace by Russian drones over the past four years. Both Wine Trader and Yara J caught fire near the mouth of the Danube River's Sulina Canal leading to the Black Sea, where ships often anchor waiting to pass because of delays from weather and congestion. Increasing attacks on Black Sea shipping connected with the Russia-Ukraine war in recent months have threatened to cause a global food crisis, as both countries are major exporters of grain, as is Romania. "We're looking at the Black Sea as a global food artery," Romanian Foreign Minister Oana Toiu told a security conference in Warsaw earlier this week. "It is currently, unfortunately, the deadliest sea when it comes to the number of casualties of sailors in the last months. That means we need to increase our investments in deterrence, defence." Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev said EU leaders would discuss on Thursday a proposed moratorium on attacks on civilian ships in the Black Sea. Russia has been bombing Ukraine's Black Sea ports, forcing Kyiv to rely increasingly on Danube River ports and shipping routes close to the coasts of Bulgaria and Romania. For its part, Ukraine has targeted Russian ships near the mouth of the Don River in the Azov Sea.

Source: Reuters/ec

item.title: 金融調節は日銀に委ねるべき、リフレ政策採る状況ではない＝城内経財相
item.description:
Rocky Swift Makiko Yamazaki
[東京 １５日 ロイター] - 城内実経済財政相は１５日、金融...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
金融調節は日銀に委ねるべき、リフレ政策採る状況ではない＝城内経財相 10/15 18:27 配信

城内実経済財政相。都内で9月撮影。 REUTERS/Manami Yamada

Rocky Swift　Makiko Yamazaki

[東京 １５日 ロイター] - 城内実経済財政相は１５日、金融政策調節は日銀に委ねるべきだとし、中央銀行の独立性を尊重する政府の立場を改めて示した。市場では追加利上げの見通しを見極める動きが続いている。

城内氏はＬＳＥＧが主催した「ロイターネクスト・ニュースメーカー」で、一般論として政府は２％の物価目標の達成に向けた金融政策運営は日銀に委ねられていると理解していると指摘。その上で、金融調節は日銀に「しっかり委ねることが大事だ」と語った。

城内氏は過去に利上げに慎重な姿勢を示したことや、景気刺激策を支持する議員グループとの関係から、市場ではリフレ派と見なされることが多い。しかし、日本はもはやリフレ政策を採用するような状況にはなく、高市政権はそうした政策を決して進めていないと述べた。

日本経済については「成長志向の新たな経済へと移行しつつある」と述べ、長年のデフレで形成された認識ではなく現状に基づき評価するよう世界の投資家に呼びかけた。

「日本経済は、長年のデフレ期とはもはや同じではない。こうした変化する現実に基づいて日本を評価してもらいたい」と指摘。「今こそ日本に投資する時だと考えている」と述べた。

城内氏は、成長のほか財政の持続可能性も重視する姿勢を示し、高市政権下での財政支出拡大を警戒する投資家の懸念払拭を図った。「『積極財政』という言葉を聞いて、単に財政規律の緩和を意味すると受け止める人もいるかもしれないが、われわれが目指しているのはそういうことではない」と述べた。

戦略的投資で日本の潜在成長力が高まれば、財政の持続可能性を維持しながら、賃金や所得、税収の増加につなげられると語った。

item.title: 英企業のコスト削減、インフレ抑制を後押し＝英中銀副総裁
item.description: [１５日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁は１５日、イラン戦争によるエネルギー価格高...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英企業のコスト削減、インフレ抑制を後押し＝英中銀副総裁 10/15 18:25 配信

イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁。ロンドンで7月代表撮影。 REUTERS

[１５日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁は１５日、イラン戦争によるエネルギー価格高騰への対応として英企業がコスト削減に取り組んでいることで、中銀はインフレを抑えやすくなるとの見方を示した。

ＣＮＢＣテレビのインタビューで「前回エネルギー価格が急騰した２０２２年と大きく異なるのは、人々がコストを価格に転嫁しようとしていない点だ」と指摘した。

「単に価格に転嫁するのではなく、ショックを吸収しようとしている。このため、先行きが不透明な中でも、われわれにとって金融政策の運営がいくらか容易になる」と語った。

国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行総会に出席するためバンコクを訪れているブリーデン氏は、現在は労働市場が弱いため、ロシアがウクライナへの全面侵攻を始めた２２年のような急激な賃金上昇は起きないことを期待しているとも述べた。

item.title: Cartier-owner Richemont considers joining bidders for De Beers, source says
item.description: Luxury group Richemont , owner of Cartier, is in talks to join a consortium bidding for diamond miner De Beers, which was put up for sale by controlling shareholder Anglo American and is valued at about $1 billion, a person familiar with the matter said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Clara Denina, Olivia Kumwenda-Mtambo
item.content:encoded: Luxury group Richemont (CFR.S) , owner of Cartier, is in talks to join a consortium bidding for diamond miner De Beers, which was put up for sale by controlling shareholder Anglo American (AAL.L) and is valued at about $1 billion, a person familiar with the matter said on Thursday. A deal would give the Swiss luxury goods group greater influence over a core element of its supply chain as natural diamond player De Beers grapples with the rapid ascent of cheaper lab-grown gems. Richemont, which is cash-rich and also owns luxury jeweller Van Cleef & Arpels, is discussing joining the Global Diamond Consortium, a group led by former De Beers CEO Gareth Penny that is vying for Anglo American's 85% stake in the world's most famous diamond miner, the person told Reuters, confirming a Bloomberg News report. Richemont, worth around $113 billion, did not respond to requests for comment. Anglo American declined to comment. Filings show Richemont had around €9 billion ($10.09 billion) in net cash at the end of June, a treasure chest worth several times the entire value of De Beers. "We view Richemont's potential participation as strategically meaningful but more about optics and long-term natural diamond category positioning than a financial event," RBC analysts said in a note. Bloomberg reported that negotiations were advanced, although there was no guarantee Richemont would join the consortium. CONSORTIUM INCLUDES SEVERAL PLAYERS Other investors are lining up. Antwerp, Belgium-based diamond-manufacturing company Pluczenik is also bidding for a stake, the company told Reuters, without disclosing the size of the stake. And US jewellery retailer Signet is in talks to join the consortium, said a source familiar with the company. Signet declined to comment. The company, which owns retail brands including KAY Jewelers, Zales and Jared, has worked with De Beers in recent years on natural diamond marketing campaigns. Shares of Signet were up 3.3% at $111.63 in US trading on Thursday. Any bid for De Beers would also depend on [USN:L8N43J0T4 TEXT:"Botswana's"] government, which owns 15% of the miner and has yet to say whether it intends to exercise a first right of refusal. A spokesperson for Botswana's presidency said on Tuesday that the government would not comment until a transaction had been concluded and signed. Officials said this summer a deal was likely to be completed in the fourth quarter of 2026. LONG SEARCH FOR A BUYER Anglo put De Beers [USN:S8N41506W TEXT:"up for sale"] in 2024 as part of a wider restructuring amid falling diamond prices and growing demand for synthetic stones. [USN:S8N41506W TEXT:"De Beers"] has mining and exploration operations in Botswana, Namibia, Angola, South Africa and Canada. Richemont Chairman and controlling shareholder Johann Rupert has affirmed his commitment to natural diamonds in high-end jewellery for his brands, as the industry works to maintain the gems' reputation as a true luxury worth the higher price. Richemont would not be the first high-end jewellery company to directly invest in the mines that produce its diamonds. British diamond brand Graff, for example, holds a 14.9% stake in Gem Diamonds (GEMD.L) , owner of the Letseng mine in Lesotho. 'MONEY PIT' Richemont shares have held up this year and outperformed the struggling luxury sector thanks to strong sales of jewellery, which consumers see as a store of value. Dan Mano, CEO of natural diamond pricing and market advisor Rapaport, said the fact so many parties were involved shows individual groups are reluctant to take a large risk in De Beers. And while Richemont is likely one of its biggest customers, there is a risk the investment becomes "a money pit," RBC analysts said. De Beers has been loss-making since 2023. Last year, it reported an underlying EBIT loss of $787 million on revenue of nearly $3.5 billion. Much depends on whether demand for mined diamonds recovers. Tobias Kormind, managing director and co-founder of jewellery brand 77 Diamonds, said that if the market is at its lowest ebb, De Beers could offer a "completely historic" opportunity. But "if this is not cyclical but structural, the demand does not improve, they waste a lot of money initially, and there's no impact," he added. De Beers CEO Al Cook [USN:S8N41506W TEXT:"told Reuters"] in June that the miner has been steadily cutting its supply of stones to the market and that diamonds would become more rare. He sees higher-quality diamonds increasingly sought after, while the price of lower quality gems remains depressed. ($1 = 0.8924 euros)

item.title: ノルウェー政府系ファンド、防衛大手への投資容認を委員会が提言
item.description:
Gwladys Fouche
[オスロ １５日 ロイター] - ノルウェー政府が設置した委員会は１５日、世界最大の政府...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ノルウェー政府系ファンド、防衛大手への投資容認を委員会が提言 10/15 18:12 配信

Gwladys Fouche

[オスロ １５日 ロイター] - ノルウェー政府が設置した委員会は１５日、世界最大の政府系ファンドであるノルウェー政府年金基金（ＳＷＦ）について、欧米の大手防衛企業への投資を認めるべきだと提言した。これらの企業は核兵器製造に関わっているとして、現在は投資対象から除外されている。

政府と議会が承認すれば、防衛企業への投資額は数百億ドルに上る可能性がある。

現行の規定では、核兵器製造に関与しているとして、欧州エアバス、米ボーイング、ロッキード・マーチン、英ＢＡＥシステムズなどの株式を取得できない。

新規定案では、核拡散防止条約（ＮＰＴ）で核兵器保有国と認められている国（米・英・仏・ロ・中）のうち、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）加盟国であるノルウェーと同盟関係にある国に本拠を置く企業は除外対象から外す。

委員会は提言で「これにより、核兵器の部品を製造する欧米企業の一部を投資対象に組み入れることが可能になる」と説明した。

ＮＡＴＯ事務総長を務めたストルテンベルグ財務相は、世界の安全保障情勢の変化やノルウェーがＮＡＴＯの「核の傘」に依存していることを理由に、委員会に倫理規定の見直しを求めていた。

投資対象から除外されている防衛関連企業には、このほか仏サフラン、タレス、米ＢＷＸテクノロジーズ、ノースロップ・グラマン、フルア、ゼネラル・ダイナミクス、ハンティントン・インガルス・インダストリーズ、ジェイコブズ・ソリューションズ、Ｌ３ハリス・テクノロジーズ、印Ｌ＆Ｔがある。

ノルウェー赤十字などの市民団体は、こうした見直しは大量破壊兵器への投資を正当化することになると主張している。赤十字は委員会に提出した意見書で「ノルウェーが巨額の資金をどのように投資するかは、世界の基準づくりに影響する」と述べた。

item.title: India's top court voids Yes Bank's $880 million AT-1 bond write-off
item.description: India's Supreme Court on Thursday set aside Yes Bank's write-off of 84 billion rupees ($883.70 million) in additional tier-1 bonds, dealing a blow to the lender and regulators that had defended the 2020 wipeout.
item.dc:creator: Arpan Chaturvedi, Ashwin Manikandan
item.content:encoded: India's Supreme Court on Thursday set aside Yes Bank's (YESB.NS) write-off of 84 billion rupees ($883.70 million) in additional tier-1 bonds, dealing a blow to the lender and regulators that had defended the 2020 wipeout. Reuters has reviewed a copy of the order. Mid-sized Indian lender Yes Bank, in which Japan's Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SUMFDS.UL) now holds a 24% stake, was declared insolvent six years ago. Under a restructuring scheme, new investors were brought in, and its [USN:L4N34523T TEXT:"AT1 bonds were written off"], while equity holders faced only a three-year lock-in on 75% of their shares. AT1 bonds are high-risk debt instruments that offer higher returns but can be written off or converted into equity when a bank comes under financial stress. Yes Bank's AT1 bondholders challenged the write-off, and the Bombay High Court ruled in their favour in 2023. Yes Bank, the Reserve Bank of India and the federal government appealed that ruling, but the Supreme Court has now upheld the lower court's decision. The Supreme Court said the bank's administrator acted under the "erroneous impression" that he retained the power to write down the bonds after the restructuring scheme was finalised, and ruled that the write-off was "impermissible". "We have good reasons to infer that the central government had taken a conscious decision to exclude the clause permitting writing down of the AT-1 Bonds from the Reconstruction Scheme," the top court said. Yes Bank shares fell as much as 14.5% after the ruling. The lender said in an exchange filing it was "in the process of obtaining and examining the final order copy of the judgment." Restoring the AT1 bonds would result in a one-time hit to Yes Bank's profit and loss account and reduce its capital adequacy ratio. "This decision creates regulatory uncertainty that can have the potential to impact investor sentiment," said Vivek Ramji Iyer, a partner and national leader for the financial services risk advisory practice at Grant Thornton. Japan's Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation bought a 24.99% stake in the Mumbai-based lender last year. RELIEF FOR BOND HOLDERS The ruling is a relief for Yes Bank's AT1 bondholders, who had argued the securities were mis-sold and could not be written off after the restructuring plan was finalised. "We now urge the bank to return our money without further delay so we can close this chapter," said Saurabh Mehta, a Bengaluru-based retail investor whose parents hold the bonds. The Supreme Court said Yes Bank had sold the bonds to individual investors in breach of RBI rules restricting such high-risk securities to institutions including mutual funds and insurers. The bank "not only permitted but actively offered" the bonds to individuals, it said. "A tighter scrutiny ought to have been exercised before luring individual investors to such high-risk securities," the court said. The court also said the RBI was "a mere bystander" as Yes Bank's core equity capital ratio fell to 0.6% by the end of 2019, against a required 7.375%. Institutional investors including Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund and Nippon India Asset Management, which held the securities, also stand to benefit from the ruling. Kotak and Nippon, however, temporarily halted subscriptions to some funds that held the bonds, citing the prospect of a sudden increase in their net asset values, which could sharply raise the price of units for new investors. ($1 = 95.0550 Indian rupees)

item.title: Cohere moves to buy AI cybersecurity startup Aisle
item.description: Canadian AI lab Cohere said on Thursday it had signed a letter of intent to buy Aisle, a San Francisco-based cybersecurity startup that uses AI to detect vulnerabilities in software.
item.dc:creator: Leo Marchandon
item.content:encoded: Canadian AI lab Cohere said on Thursday it had signed a letter of intent to buy Aisle, a San Francisco-based cybersecurity startup that uses AI to detect vulnerabilities in software. The terms of the deal were not disclosed. The tie-up would add cybersecurity to the business entity Cohere is assembling through its [USN:L6N4580NZ TEXT:"merger with Germany's Aleph Alpha"], a combination reported to be worth about $20 billion. It would also extend its European footprint with Aisle's engineering hub in Prague. Cohere said the acquisition reflected its continued investment in Europe and would deepen its presence across the region, strengthening European AI. The deal is aimed at boosting the combined group's security and threat detection capabilities for enterprise and public sector clients, with private deployment available on the customer's own system. "Increasingly capable AI systems are transforming both cybersecurity and the threats organizations face, and defensive capabilities must advance just as quickly," Cohere said. Aisle was founded in 2025 by Ondrej Vlcek, former CEO of Czech antivirus maker Avast, with co-founders from Google (GOOGL.O) DeepMind and Anthropic. Vlcek will join Cohere to lead its new cybersecurity unit, while Aisle Chief Operating Officer Jaya Baloo will become its chief information security officer and Aisle's 50 full-time employees will join Cohere, the Canadian company told Reuters. Aisle said its AI found more than 500 new bugs in widely used software in its first year, including 12 vulnerabilities in OpenSSL, a free program that encrypts internet traffic for banks, governments and messaging apps. The bugs were fixed after their discovery.

item.title: アングル：ＡＩ株売りに勢い、資金調達に懸念 クライマックスには距離
item.description:
Noriyuki Hirata
[東京 １５日 ロイター] - １５日の東京市場では人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の下げに勢い...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アングル：ＡＩ株売りに勢い、資金調達に懸念　クライマックスには距離 10/15 17:58 配信

10月15日、都内の株価ボード前で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 １５日 ロイター] - １５日の東京市場では人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の下げに勢いがつき、日経平均は直近高値から６０００円超の下げとなった。ＡＩデータセンター投資に向けた資金調達への懸念がつきまとう中、これまでの期待に基づく買いが巻き戻された形だが、追い証（追加保証金）が多発してセリング・クライマックス（総悲観の投げ売り）をつけるには、なお距離があるとの見方もある。

＜落ちるナイフの局面＞

日経平均はこの日、一時５％超下落し、約１カ月ぶりに６万４０００円近辺まで値を下げた。アドバンテストが約１５％安、ソフトバンクグループが９％安、フジクラが１２％超安とＡＩ関連の主力株が軒並み大きく下げたが、松井証券の窪田朋一郎チーフマーケットアナリストは「まだ落ちてくるナイフを拾っている局面だ」として、大底前の総投げとなるセリング・クライマックスには距離があるとの見方を示す。

株価下落局面の「位置」を把握するうえで注目される指標の一つに信用評価損益率がある。信用取引で買い建てている投資家がどの程度含み損益を抱えているかを表す指標で、マイナス２０％を下回ると追加の担保金差し入れを求められる追い証が発生しやすい。期日までに対応できなければ損失覚悟の処分売りを迫られ、こうした投げが集中するとセリング・クライマックスにつながりやすいとされる。

松井証券店内では１４日時点の評価損益率がマイナス８％。この日の急落を加味してもマイナス１１％程度と松井の窪田氏はみており「日経平均で６万円を割るぐらいでないと、本格的な投げにはなりにくそうだ」と話す。

＜ＡＩ株売りの背景＞

ＡＩ株売りが強まった背景のひとつとして、ＡＩ向けクラウドサービス大手コアウィーブの社債や株価急落への警戒感がある。

同社の５年物ＣＤＳ（クレジット・デフォルト・スワップ）はこのところ、８００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）付近の高水準にあったが、この数日で１１００ｂｐまで拡大した。社債利回りも上がっており、追加の資金調達コストの増加が警戒された。「（データセンターに大規模投資するハイテク大手の）ハイパースケーラーによる資金調達にも波及しかねないとの懸念が強まった」と大和証券の坪井裕豪チーフストラテジストは指摘する。

ハイパースケーラーはこれまで、本業で稼いだ現金を意味する営業キャッシュフロー（ＣＦ）で投資をまかなってきたが、今年に入って営業ＣＦの流入額を投資ＣＦの流出額が上回る企業が出始め、投資継続には資金調達が重要な局面に入ってきている。データセンター投資が鈍るようなら、これまで米ハイテク大手による巨額投資の恩恵が及ぶとみられていた半導体やその製造装置、周辺インフラなどの「ツルハシ銘柄」を巡るシナリオも変わってくる可能性がある。

＜ＩＰＯ先送り＞

企業の資金需要を市場がこなせるか、懸念がくすぶる中、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）の動向にも市場の関心は向かっている。

ＡＩ関連では、ＡＩデータセンター関連会社でソフトバンクグループが支援するＳＢエナジーが米国でのＩＰＯロードショー（投資家説明）の開始を先送りしたことが９月に報じられたほか、米ブラックストーンが支援する豪データセンター運営会社エアトランクがシンガポールでのＲＥＩＴ（不動産投資信託）ＩＰＯを２７年に延期したと伝わっている。

市場では、１０─１１月にもと観測されていたＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックのＩＰＯが１１月の米中間選挙後にずれ込む可能性が高いとも伝わっている。評価額２兆ドル規模との試算もある同社のＩＰＯが「延期になったり（評価額が）２兆ドル規模を下回るようだと、売りの口実にされかねない」と松井の窪田氏はみている。

＜焦点は企業業績＞

「米中間選挙のある年の１０月は海外勢が売り越す傾向にあり、きょうの下げにもつながっている可能性がある」と東海東京インテリジェンス・ラボの山藤将太エクイティマーケットアナリストは指摘する。一方、「ここから企業業績に目が向かうとすれば、買い戻しが入ってくる余地もありそうだ」という。

大和の坪井氏は、資金調達の難しさが成長途上の企業に限られる話かどうかを見極める必要があるとの見方を示す一方、目先の焦点は、１０月下旬に本格化する米ハイテク企業の決算だと指摘する。「ＡＩビジネスの収益性が確認されれば、不透明感は和らぎ得る」と坪井氏は話している。

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国14カ月ぶり安値、米利上げ観測嫌気
item.description: [上海 １５日 ロイター] - 中国市場は下落し１４カ月ぶりの安値で引けた。予想を上回る米インフレ指標を受けて追加利上...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国14カ月ぶり安値、米利上げ観測嫌気 10/15 17:51 配信

[上海 １５日 ロイター] - 中国市場は下落し１４カ月ぶりの安値で引けた。予想を上回る米インフレ指標を受けて追加利上げ観測が強まり、ハイテク株を中心に世界的に株安が広がった流れを引き継いだ。

上海総合指数とＣＳＩ３００指数はともに１．６％下落。いずれも２０２５年８月以来の安値で引けた。

上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は１．５％安、深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は２．９％下落した。

ＵＢＳ証券の中国株ストラテジスト、レイ・モン氏は「最近の調整は、過熱していたハイテク株の持ち高解消が集中的に進んだことが主因とみられる。投資信託も、元本回復時の解約に関連した圧力に直面している」と指摘。「地政学リスク、米国債利回り、原油価格のボラティリティーがインフレ期待に影響を及ぼし、ドルの流動性が引き締まった結果、市場のリスク選好を圧迫している」と指摘した。

前日の米国市場では、消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回る伸びとなり、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げに動く可能性があるとの観測が一時再燃したことで、ドルが上昇する一方、米株は下落した。

投資家の関心は１９日に発表される中国の第３・四半期国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計に向かっている。貿易から融資まで一連の指標が好調だった中、景気回復の勢いを見極める材料となる。

国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１５日、アジアの経済成長が２０２７年に減速するとの見通しを示した。イラン戦争に伴うエネルギーショックや人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームの調整の可能性、世界的な債券利回り上昇の波及によるリスクが高まっていると警告した。

香港市場ではハンセン指数が１％下落し、ハンセンテック指数は２．７％安となった。アリババの香港上場株は３．７％下落。

item.title: 中国の長期金利が15カ月ぶり低水準、流動性潤沢 緩和観測も
item.description: ［上海 １５日 ロイター］ - 中国の長期金利が１５日、１５カ月ぶりの水準に低下した。中国人民銀行（中央銀行）が流動性...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国の長期金利が15カ月ぶり低水準、流動性潤沢　緩和観測も 10/15 17:49 配信

人民元紙幣。2022年4月撮影。 REUTERS/Florence Lo/Illustration

［上海　１５日　ロイター］ - 中国の長期金利が１５日、１５カ月ぶりの水準に低下した。中国人民銀行（中央銀行）が流動性を潤沢な状態に保っていることが背景。トレーダーは、金融政策の手がかりを得ようと、来週開催される金融関連会合に注目している。

・中国銀行間市場は今週、資金が潤沢な状態。翌日物レポ金利の平均は１．２５％前後と約５カ月ぶりの低水準。これは、伝えられている人民銀の翌日物リバースレポオペの金利とほぼ同じ水準。

・潤沢な流動性が長期金利を押し下げた。１０年物国債利回りは１．６４％と２０２５年７月以来の低水準に、３０年物利回りは２．０５％に低下した。

・１３日以降、期日を迎えるリバースレポはなかったが、人民銀は７日物オペで資金供給を続けた。また３カ月物と６カ月物の買い切り型リバースレポで、１０月に入ってから差し引き４０００億元（５９７億７０００万ドル）を供給している。

・興業証券のアナリストによると、市場は来週の「金融街フォーラム」を前に金融緩和を織り込み始めた。具体的な措置については、預金準備率や金利の引き下げのほか、人民銀が政策金利の基準を翌日物リバースレポ金利に移し、事実上の利下げに踏み切るとの見方がでている。

・現在、主要な政策金利は７日物リバースレポ金利で、水準は１．４％。

・金融街フォーラムは１９─２２日に北京で開かれ、規制当局が改革政策を打ち出す予定。人民銀の潘功勝総裁は、これまでのフォーラムで政策の枠組みの変更を発表してきた。２５年のフォーラムでは、公開市場での国債売買の再開を表明した。

item.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq pare declines as AI rout teeters; healthcare, staples gain
item.description: The S&P 500 recouped most of its early losses to trade near flat on Thursday as a selloff in AI stocks eased and investors rotated into defensive sectors as fresh data pointed to building US price pressures.
item.dc:creator: Sruthi Shankar, Purvi Agarwal
item.content:encoded: The S&P 500 recouped most of its early losses to trade near flat on Thursday as a selloff in AI stocks eased and investors rotated into defensive sectors as fresh data pointed to building US price pressures. The Nasdaq neared a one-month low earlier in the session as tech stocks lost ground after TSMC (2330.TW) struck [USN:L1N461004 TEXT:"a cautious note"] on 2027. Reports of a 45% sequential jump in [USN:L6N4601AA TEXT:"Anthropic's"] quarterly revenue offered little reprieve. By the afternoon, most stocks recovered from declines on Thursday. Cloud computing giant Oracle reversed course to gain 2.1%. The S&P 500 information technology (.SPLRCT) sector lost 1.1%, with gains in software stocks and tech heavyweights such as Microsoft (MSFT.O) cushioning the fall. Chipmaker Nvidia (NVDA.O) was down 1.9% and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) lost 4%. The broader Philadelphia semiconductor index (.SOX) fell 2.4%, putting it on track for a seventh straight decline and nearly $2 trillion in combined market-value losses in the period. On the flip side, traditionally defensive sectors continued to rise, with healthcare (.SPXHC) and consumer staples (.SPLRCS) adding 2.6% and 1%, respectively. Drugmaker Eli Lilly (LLY.N) gained 5.2%, UnitedHealth (UNH.N) was up 4%, while Walmart rose 2.3% after a rating upgrade by Deutsche Bank. "That is emblematic of a defensive rotation. It's because of the worry that maybe some sort of a debt crisis is emerging," said Sam Stovall, chief investment strategist at CFRA Research. Still, heavily indebted data-center operator CoreWeave (CRWV.O) lost 1.3% after a 15% drop on Wednesday. Its bonds also fell, pushing yields to record highs. "There has been growing concern about the cash flow reality underlying the AI narrative and has been building at a time that rates have been rising and (interest) rate volatility is increasing," said Jordan Rizzuto, CIO at GammaRoad Capital Partners. "To the degree that rate volatility persists, we would expect credit related pressures to continue to mount for such (indebted) companies." At 12:44 p.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 457.99 points, or 0.89%, to 52,078.61, the S&P 500 (.SPX) gained 3.74 points, or 0.05%, to 7,722.68, and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) fell 126.38 points, or 0.47%, to 26,566.48. The CBOE Volatility Index (.VIX) , considered Wall Street's fear gauge, hit a two-week high on Thursday and was swinging between gains and losses. Data showed US producer prices [USN:L1N460127 TEXT:"increased by the most"] in 4-1/2 years in September amid rising goods and services costs, the latest indication of inflation broadening out beyond energy products. Markets will now scrutinize Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's speech before the International Monetary Fund Annual Meeting. [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"Hotter-than-expected consumer inflation data"] on Wednesday had fueled expectations of further interest-rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve, after which the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq marked their biggest one-day fall since July. Shares of [USN:L4N46023Y TEXT:"Rocket Lab"] (RKLB.O) dropped 10.9% after the space company said the inaugural launch of its new, larger Neutron rocket was delayed until next year. FMC (FMC.N) slid over 31% after the agrichemicals company [USN:L4N46114X TEXT:"sharply cut"] its third-quarter outlook, which includes a $625 million-$675 million hit from commercial actions. Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 2.34-to-1 ratio on the NYSE and by a 1.52-to-1 ratio on the Nasdaq. The S&P 500 posted 23 new 52-week highs and no new lows, while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 51 new highs and 351 new lows.

item.title: スペイン世論調査、与党支持率34％で大差の首位 来月総選挙
item.description: [マドリード １４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[マドリード １４日 ロイター] - スペインの国営世論調査機関ＣＩＳが１４日に公表した１０月の調査によると、現時点で選挙が実施された場合、与党・社会労働党（ＰＳＯＥ）の予想得票率が３４％となり、野党・国民党（ＰＰ）の２２．２％を大きく上回る見通し。

・サンチェス首相は、自身が率いる少数与党政権の住宅対策が議会で否決されたことを受け、総選挙を１１月に前倒し実施すると決めた。

・調査は１０月第１週、住宅危機を巡る抗議活動が全国で続く中、５０２５人を対象に実施された。立ち退きを強いられたことが抗議活動のきっかけとなった住宅問題の活動家マリカルメン・アバスカル氏が７日に病院で死去する前に行われた。

・予想得票率の３位は極右政党のボックスで１７．１％。ＰＳＯＥの連立相手で急進左派のスマールは６．１％と後れを取った。スマールは総選挙に向け、他の左派政党との共闘を引き続き協議している。

・一方、他の大半の世論調査では、保守派のＰＰと極右ボックスが合わせて議会の過半数を確保するとの見通しとなっている。

・ＣＩＳの調査では、首相に望ましい人物としてサンチェス氏の支持率が引き続き最高の３９．３％と、ＰＰのアルベルト・ヌニェス・フェイホー党首の１４．７％を２４．６％ポイント上回った。ボックスのサンティアゴ・アバスカル党首は１３．８％だった。

・有権者の懸念事項では住宅問題が首位に急浮上し、スペインの最大の問題として挙げた割合は過去最高の５５．７％と、前月を２０ポイント上回った。次いで移民問題の２０．９％、経済情勢の２０．３％となった。

item.title: Pakistan school roof collapse kills 28; more deaths feared
item.description: A rescue official said the ceiling came down on the students after the roof of a higher floor collapsed, crumpling the two storeys.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Pakistan school roof collapse kills 28; more deaths feared

A rescue official said the ceiling came down on the students after the roof of a higher floor collapsed, crumpling the two storeys.

ISLAMABAD: At least 27 students, most younger than 13, were killed in Pakistan on Thursday (Oct 15), along with a teacher, when a school roof collapsed during classes in the northwestern city of Peshawar, authorities said, warning that the death toll could rise. Television images showed ambulances rushing to the site at the privately-run Al-Khair Education Center school while rescuers pulled bloodied students from the rubble. "We have taken out at least 45 children," said district emergency officer Iftikhar Khan, adding that some more children were reported to be buried in the rubble.

Army soldiers and rescue workers gather after a school roof collapse in Peshawar Pakistan, on Oct 15, 2026. (Photo: Reuters)

Rescue teams were working to extricate bodies and take the injured to hospital, said government official Bilal Faizi.

Twenty injured and most of the dead were brought to the city's Lady Reading Hospital, its spokesperson, Mohammad Asim, said. A rescue official said the ceiling came down on the students after the roof of a higher floor collapsed, crumpling the two storeys. Authorities said an investigation had been ordered to determine the cause.

Peshawar police chief Mian Saeed said he feared the death toll could rise as just 47 of the 110 students in three classrooms at the time had been rescued. "It was a weak building structure," Saeed added. "Its roof was overweight with construction on a weak structure that caused the collapse." There was no immediate comment from school officials.

item.title: オアシス、ニデック株を買い増し 9％に
item.description: [東京 １５日 ロイター] - 香港の投資ファンド、オアシス・マネジメントが、ニデック株の保有比率を９．００％に引き...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
オアシス、ニデック株を買い増し　9％に 10/15 16:51 配信

都内のニデックのオフィスで9月撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada

[東京 １５日 ロイター] - 香港の投資ファンド、オアシス・マネジメントが、ニデック株の保有比率を９．００％に引き上げたことが１５日提出の変更報告書で分かった。これまでの保有は７．９７％だった。報告義務発生日は１０月７日。

保有目的は引き続き、株式の価値変動や配当による利益取得だとした。こうした目的を達成するために、すでに実施している役員の選任・構成の変更、上場廃止、資本政策の変更などに関する提案に加え、今後１２カ月以内に重要財産の処分や取得、代表取締役の選定・解任などに関する提案も行う予定という。

オアシスは７日、ニデック取締役会に対し、非公開化に向けた初期的検討を開始するよう要請すると発表していた。同社の有価証券報告書に独立監査人から「意見不表明」が付され、適正意見を自力で取得できる保証がない中、「意図せぬ上場廃止リスク」に備えるべきだと主張している。

item.description:
Shinichi Uchida
［東京 １５日 ロイター］ - 東宝は１５日、２０２７年２月期業績予想を修正すると発...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
東宝、営業利益予想据え置き　「ちいかわ」ヒットは織り込み済み 10/15 16:45 配信

Shinichi Uchida

［東京　１５日　ロイター］ - 東宝は１５日、２０２７年２月期業績予想を修正すると発表した。有価証券一部売却により純利益は前年比７．３％減の４８０億円に上方修正（従来予想は４１０億円）したが、営業収入や営業利益は従来予想を維持した。「ちいかわ」や１１月公開の「ゴジラー０．０」の一定のヒットは織り込み済みで、下期大型作品の初動を慎重に見極めた。

２６年３─８月期（中間期）は、営業利益は前年比２４．８％減の３０９億円、純利益は同４０．２％減の２００億円だった。映画事業では前年に大ヒットした「鬼滅の刃」「国宝」の反動があったほか、人件費や減価償却費が増加した。

item.title: ベイカレント、資本政策を一部変更 成長投資も重視
item.description: [東京 １５日 ロイター] - ベイカレントは１５日、 株主還元に関し、予想売上収益の約２５％に相当するキャッシュを...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ベイカレント、資本政策を一部変更　成長投資も重視 10/15 16:43 配信

[東京 １５日 ロイター] - ベイカレントは１５日、 株主還元に関し、予想売上収益の約２５％に相当するキャッシュを毎年確保した上で余剰キャッシュを将来的な成長投資と自社株買いに機動的に配分する方針に見直すと発表した。株主還元を充実させると同時に成長投資を推進する。

従来は予想売上収益の約４０％を毎年確保すべきキャッシュ水準の最大値と定め、これを超える余剰キャッシュを自社株買いを中心とする株主還元に充てていた。

配当については、国際会計基準ベースで配当性向４０％を目安にする方針を維持した。成長投資の対象は事業強化・拡充のためのＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）や主要顧客との合弁事業などが含まれる。

同時に発表した２０２７年２月期中間期（２６年３─８月）決算は、純利益が前年比２８．９％増の２２２億円だった。通期の見通しは据え置いた。年間配当は１３０円と、前期比３０円の増配を計画している。

item.title: 訂正-政府・公的機関がドル以外での調達拡大、資金獲得競争激化＝シティ
item.description:
(英文の訂正により、見出しおよび１段落目の「政府系ファンド」を「政府・公的機関」に訂正します)
Selena Li
...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
訂正-政府・公的機関がドル以外での調達拡大、資金獲得競争激化＝シティ 10/15 16:39 配信

2023年1月、バンコクの銀行で扱われている米ドル紙幣と中国人民元紙幣。 REUTERS/Athit Perawongmetha

(英文の訂正により、見出しおよび１段落目の「政府系ファンド」を「政府・公的機関」に訂正します)

Selena Li

［バンコク　１５日　ロイター］ - 米シティグループによると、政府・公的機関（訂正）が、ドル以外での資金調達を増やしている。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の資金調達が活発な中、調達コストが上昇しており、調達先の多様化に向けて人民元、豪ドル、香港ドル、シンガポールドル建ての調達に関心が示されているという。

シティの公共部門グループのグローバル責任者を務めるステファニー・フォンフリーデブルク氏は、国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行年次総会が開催されているタイのバンコクでロイターの取材に応じ、「資本のパイは限られている。ここ何年もなかったことだが、公共部門のソブリン（国家）と民間企業がその資本を奪い合っている。それを主に引き起こしているのは、借り入れを必要とするソブリンだ」と述べた。

政府系ファンド（ＳＷＦ）は世界最大の機関投資家グループだ。グローバルＳＷＦのデータによると、世界のＳＷＦの資産総額は１０月時点で約１６兆５０００億ドルに上る。

格付け会社フィッチは１３日公表したリポートで、経済規模が世界上位１０カ国の１０年物国債利回りが年初から平均８１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇したと指摘した。

フォンフリーデブルク氏によると、ソブリンなどの公共部門の投資家は、インフラ、エネルギー安全保障、防衛、開発といった優先課題の資金を賄うため、債券発行を増やそうとしているが、民間部門でＡＩ関連投資が活発になっているため、資金獲得競争が厳しくなっている。

先進国で利回りが上昇し、巨額の民間資本がＡＩインフラへの投資に回っているため、途上国が資金調達市場から締め出されていると述べた。途上国はもともと債務返済の負担が重く、財政余力も乏しいため、「開発のための債務スワップ」のような新しい代替策を使わなければ、エネルギー、運輸、デジタル分野の将来に向けた資金を確保するのに苦労するだろうと述べた。

また、金価格の上昇を受け、外貨準備の運用担当者がヘッジや流動性管理、金準備を担保にした借り入れといった手段を検討しているという。

ただ同氏は、市場の厚みと流動性で米ドルに並ぶ市場はほかにないため、米ドルの主導的地位は当面揺らがないとの見方を示した。
